description:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

We are looking for an Mid-Market Account Executive to join our team of high performing Account Executives in the DACH region. Figma is growing and moving fast. Our next team member will have an agile, dynamic mindset, be comfortable embracing change and a true team-player. You won’t be alone! Figma has an incredible team and you’ll work closely with other groups including Support, Design, Engineering, Product Marketing, Customer Success, and Community. You will report directly to our Commercial Sales Manager who is also based in Berlin, Germany.

This is a full time role in our Berlin office within a hybrid environment or remote. 

What you’ll do at Figma:

  • Build a strong sales pipeline while exceeding quarterly and annual sales targets
  • Work closely with cross functional teams to ensure sales effectiveness 
  • Establish and maintain relationships with key stakeholders within Enterprise accounts
  • Be part of a team dedicated to promoting Figma to existing and new customers
  • Help build the foundation and processes for all customer facing teams at Figma
  • Work with a dedicated set of customers, each with up to 5,000 employees

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • 3+ years of closing experience working with customers, ideally with a SaaS product
  • Excited about working in a fast-paced environment and helping improve business processes as we grow
  • Desire to learn a technical product and effectively communicate Figma’s value to potential customers
  • Ambitious self-starter who’s eager to learn while being a core part of building our business from the ground up 
  • High attention to detail with excellent written and verbal communication
  • Fluency in German

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Experience selling to technical audiences
  • Experience with UX/UI design principles and collaboration tools
  • Proven experience using a sales methodology, ideally Command of the Message or MEDDICC
At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

At Figma we celebrate and support our differences. We know employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, our product and our community to flourish. Figma is an equal opportunity workplace - we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity/expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to apply for a role, participate in the interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require accommodation, please reach out to

Examples of accommodations include but are not limited to: 

  • Holding interviews in an accessible location
  • Enabling closed captioning on video conferencing
  • Ensuring all written communication be compatible with screen readers
  • Changing the mode or format of interviews 

To ensure the integrity of our hiring process and facilitate a more personal connection, we require all candidates keep their cameras on during video interviews. Additionally, if hired you will be required to attend in person onboarding.

By applying for this job, the candidate acknowledges and agrees that any personal data contained in their application or supporting materials will be processed in accordance with Figma's Candidate Privacy Notice.

Application limits: To help candidates focus on the opportunities most relevant to their skills and experience, Figma limits the number and frequency of applications. These limits apply to all roles:

  • Candidates may submit up to 5 applications during any rolling 30-day period.
  • Candidates may not reapply to the same role while an application is active or within 90 days of receiving a rejection.

Once the applicable days has passed, candidates are welcome to apply again.

description: Werde Account Manager (m/w/d) mit Fokus Digital Media bei Carwow in München. Du verkaufst unsere digitalen Mediaprodukte YouTube, Meta und Data an Automobilhersteller, Partner und Mediaagenturen und begleitest die Kampagnen von der Buchung bis zur Aussteuerung. Du bist dir nicht ganz sicher, ob die Position zu dir passt? Bewirb dich und lass es uns gemeinsam herausfinden. Unsere Mission Carwow ist Europas führende Plattform für den Autowechsel. Wir verändern, wie Menschen Autos kaufen, verkaufen und leasen. Mit Technologie, Medien und Automotive Expertise haben wir uns von einer reinen Bewertungsplattform zu einem der größten Online-Marktplätze entwickelt. Unsere Reichweite geht weit über die eigene Plattform hinaus: 10 Mio. YouTube Abonnenten und mehr als 350 Mio. Online Leser pro Jahr in der Gruppe. Genau diese Reichweite und unsere Daten machen wir jetzt für Werbekunden auch außerhalb von Carwow nutzbar. Dein Impact @ Carwow Du baust die Säule Digital Media, Audiences und Data im deutschen OEM & Media Team aus. Unsere Brand Partnerships Manager:innen verkaufen Retail Media auf der Plattform. Du sorgst dafür, dass Carwow auch in den Mediaplänen der Agenturen fest gesetzt ist. Dafür hast du drei Produkte im Gepäck. Du schnürst daraus Pakete, die zu den Zielen der Partner passen und verbindest sie mit unserem Retail Media Angebot zu einer durchgängigen Media Story bis zum Kauf. description: Als Accounts Payable & Financial Controller ben je medeverantwoordelijk voor de juistheid, volledigheid en tijdigheid van onze financiële administratie — een van de belangrijkste pijlers voor het nemen van beslissingen binnen Crisp. Je combineert de dagelijkse sturing op de crediteurenadministratie met uitdagende controlewerkzaamheden, data-analyses en het automatiseren van onze processen met behulp van moderne tools en AI. Wat je gaat doen Je werkt elke dag met een gezellig team vol gedreven mensen. We hebben ervaring in business control, accounting, corporate finance, data analytics, fiscaal recht en auditing. Crisp groeit snel, en de verantwoordelijkheden van ons team dus ook. Zo is geen dag hetzelfde en blijven we onszelf continu ontwikkelen. We sparren veel en staan open voor elkaars mening. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het verwerken en controleren van inkomende facturen en declaraties. Je staat leveranciers te woord, beheert de mailstroom en zet betalingen klaar. Je stuurt een team van werkstudenten en stagiaires aan en zorgt er samen met hen voor dat alle facturen tijdig en correct worden verwerkt. Je ondersteunt bij de maandafsluiting, controleert grootboekrekeningen en helpt mee met ad-hoc analyses en periodieke rapportages. Je denkt actief mee over het slim inrichten van financiële workflows. Je verkent en implementeert mogelijkheden voor procesautomatisering, slimme datakoppelingen en AI-oplossingen (zoals OCR-herkenning en geautomatiseerde factuurverwerking). Je rapporteert aan de Lead Financial Controller, die je ondersteunt in je dagelijkse werkzaamheden en je helpt om door te groeien in je rol. Dit ben jij Als ideale kandidaat heb je al een basis aan kennis en ervaring en wil je blijven leren in een vakgebied dat continu verandert en digitaliseert. Je herkent jezelf in het volgende profiel: Je beschikt over een afgeronde hbo- of universitaire opleiding (bijvoorbeeld Finance, Bedrijfseconomie of Accountancy). Je hebt 0-3 jaar relevante werkervaring in een financiële of control-functie. Je hebt ervaring met de crediteurenadministratie en het verwerken en controleren van facturen. Kennis van accountingsoftware (zoals Exact) is een pré. Je bent handig met data en hebt een sterke affiniteit met automatisering en nieuwe technologieën (zoals AI-tools, data-integraties en procesoptimalisatie). Je schrijft en spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Je bent integer, nauwkeurig en risicobewust. Je begrijpt dat een strakke administratie de basis vormt voor goede besluitvorming. Je denkt in kansen en mogelijkheden: je ziet direct waar processen sneller, slimmer of foutlozer kunnen en schroomt niet om dit op te pakken. Wat wij bieden Werken bij een B Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op het Europese voedselsysteem. 27 vakantiedagen om bij te komen en op te laden. Een extra vrije dag per jaar om je in te zetten voor vrijwilligerswerk en iets goeds te doen. Aandacht voor je mentale gezondheid met online begeleiding van erkende psychologen via OpenUp. Voor straks een perfect pensioen via BPFL. Elke maand food for thought, met workshops en talks via de Crisp University. Regelmatig tastings of workshops op kantoor of bij een van onze leveranciers, om te zien hoe onze lekkerste producten worden gemaakt – en natuurlijk ook te proeven. Dagelijks een uitgebreide, georganiseerde lunch op kantoor. Enthousiaste, slimme collega’s en tijd om elkaar te leren kennen tijdens sport, events en proeverijen. En... fikse korting op je Crisp boodschappen, omdat je thuis natuurlijk ook goed wilt eten. Onze selectieprocedure Solliciteer via onderstaande button. Hoe meer je kunt delen over jezelf en de reden dat je solliciteert, hoe beter. Bij Crisp streven we naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen welkom is, ongeacht hun achtergrond, geslacht, leeftijd, etniciteit, seksuele geaardheid, religie of beperking. description: ad/mbo-praktijkstage, vanaf februari 2027 Ben jij iemand die graag orde schept in de chaos? Krijg je energie van uitzoeken, structureren en dingen overzichtelijk maken? Werk je graag met digitale systemen? Dit is jouw uitdaging We hebben honderden documenten met informatie over ons beleid en genomen besluiten. Deze documenten zijn relevant voor veel collega’s. Om die reden willen we de documenten graag op een overzichtelijke manier aanbieden, zodat alle collega’s snel en makkelijk het document kunnen vinden dat ze zoeken. We hebben al een idee hoe we dit willen gaan doen. Tijdens jouw stage ga je ons idee verder uitwerken en in de praktijk toepassen. Dit zijn de concrete activiteiten: Je gaat alle beleidsdocumenten verzamelen die nu nog op verschillende plekken zijn opgeslagen. Je maakt een mappenstructuur aan, waarin de documenten op een logische plek komen te staan. Je deelt de documenten in volgens de nieuwe structuur en voorziet ze van labels en metadata voor een optimale vindbaarheid. Je controleert of documenten dubbel voorkomen en verwijdert dubbele, verouderde en niet meer relevante documenten. Je kijkt of de nieuwe structuur in de praktijk goed werkt en of gebruikers de documenten gemakkelijk kunnen terugvinden. Je signaleert knelpunten en doet waar nodig voorstellen voor verbeteringen. Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Heerlen Je loopt stage bij het team Staf van Dataverzameling (DVZ) van het CBS in Heerlen. Vanuit deze directie wordt een groot deel van de data verzameld die het CBS nodig heeft voor zijn werk. Je krijgt dus een kijkje achter de schermen bij een organisatie die dagelijks met veel verschillende soorten data werkt. Jouw stageopdracht gaat over kwaliteitszorg voor alle teams binnen DVZ. Je staat er tijdens je stage natuurlijk niet alleen voor: je hebt collega’s om je heen bij wie je terechtkunt met vragen en ideeën. De sfeer op de afdeling is informeel en gezellig. Collega’s zijn makkelijk aanspreekbaar en helpen elkaar graag. Natuurlijk wordt er hard gewerkt, maar er is ook tijd voor een praatje bij de koffieautomaat of een gezamenlijke lunch. Als je wilt, kun je tijdens de lunch ook aansluiten bij een lunchwandeling. Kortom: je krijgt bij ons de ruimte om praktijkervaring op te doen, nieuwe dingen te leren en echt mee te werken in een team. Dit breng jij mee Je volgt een ad- of mbo-opleiding informatiebeheer, administratie, business services of management support. Je hebt kennis van en wellicht ervaring met: Het werken met documenten en informatie en deze op een overzichtelijke manier ordenen. Het werken met digitale programma’s en systemen en het snel wegwijs worden in nieuwe systemen. Nauwkeurig en gestructureerd werken en het leuk vinden om dingen netjes en overzichtelijk te maken. Samenwerken en overleggen met collega’s, vragen stellen en meedenken over hoe iets beter of makkelijker kan. Je werkt graag netjes en gestructureerd, bent betrouwbaar en vindt het leuk om nieuwe dingen te leren. Je pakt uit jezelf dingen op, denkt mee en stelt vragen als iets niet duidelijk is. Ook vind je het prettig om samen te werken en makkelijk contact te maken met collega’s. Dit kun je van ons verwachten Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je: praktijkervaring opdoet met document- en informatiebeheer en leert hoe je informatie overzichtelijk en goed vindbaar maakt; zelfstandig aan de slag gaat, maar ook samenwerkt en overlegt met collega’s; leert hoe je duidelijk communiceert, vragen stelt en goed afstemt met je stagebegeleider; leert om problemen en verbeterpunten op tijd te herkennen en deze samen met je collega’s te bespreken; feedback krijgt en en toepast, zodat je tijdens je stage steeds meer leert en groeit in je werkzaamheden. description: About Hexa Hexa (formerly eFounders) gives entrepreneurs the best chances to build outstanding companies. We are a pioneering, world-leading startup studio born in Europe that designs, builds and launches category-defining startups. We are today recognized as one of the best venture studios in the world, with a track record comparable to tier-1 VC funds. We have created 60+ companies (including 3 unicorns) with a combined valuation of over $5 billion, among them Aircall, Spendesk, Front, Swan and Yousign. Hexa is in full growth mode, with three early-stage activities: our Ventures programs Hexa Start and Hexa Sprint which help entrepreneurs go from zero to one, and a PE program, Hexa Scale, which takes majority stakes in existing startups and pushes them to new thresholds. The hardware vertical at Hexa: Frontier Tech Frontier Tech is Hexa’s studio focused on physical tech, led by Guerric de Crombrugghe. We build companies that move atoms: real machines, deployed in the field, often for defense, energy, space and critical infrastructure. A few examples of what is on the bench today include containerized atmospheric water generators, expendable turbojets, and ship-borne satellite ground stations. Our edge is velocity. We go from idea to working hardware with small teams and lean budgets, against legacy players with hundreds of engineers and decade-long programs. AI is now the biggest lever we have to widen that gap, today by speeding up how we build, and tomorrow by shaping what kind of companies we build. Why this role, why now AI for hardware is moving faster than any team can track. Our internal map now tracks close to 200 tools, from text-to-CAD, AI-native electronics and physics surrogates to manufacturing, test data, procurement and the MCP connectors that let agents drive CAD and EDA tools directly. Most of these tools will not matter. A handful will cut weeks off our programs. We need someone whose job is to find those, prove them on our real parts, and put them in the hands of our founders before our competitors do. The mission We’re looking for an industrial hardware engineer who is 100% AI-pilled, with a dual objective: Adopt AI inside our startups. Make every Frontier Tech venture the fastest-moving hardware team in its category, using the best AI tools available today. Build companies that grow with AI. Design products and business models that are both AI-enabled (they get better with every new generation of models) and AI-enablers (they feed AI with the data, compute, energy or infrastructure it needs), and run the companies themselves on AI from day one. The goal is a positive feedback loop: the more AI grows, the more our companies grow. Adoption is the immediate focus. The role splits into two: 80%: deploy AI inside our ventures Hands-on, embedded in the teams, measured by weeks saved. Map the bottlenecks. Sit with each venture and map its engineering workflow, from requirements to design, simulation, electronics, firmware, test, manufacturing and documentation. Find the steps that cost the most weeks. Do the engineering. You are part of the team, not an advisor. You will run the CAD, set up the simulations, push the PCB, write the firmware agent, build the digital twin, produce the documentation, build the tools that automate technical pre-sales material that wins a contract. You ship parts and files, not slides. Run the shared AI infrastructure. Set up and maintain the agents, repos and connectors between tools (CAD, EDA, simulation, data), with a common setup across ventures, so founders spend their time engineering rather than configuring. Make it stick. Start with hands-on workshops on each team’s real problems, then train founders and engineers, write the playbooks, and track real adoption so tools are used every day rather than demoed once. 20%: studio radar and partnerships Keep the map alive. Track the AI-for-hardware landscape and what frontier labs ship, and maintain our living map of tools, maturity and pricing. See beyond the hype. Our founders want evidence, not promises. Benchmark tools on our own parts and problems, not on vendor demos, and tell the studio plainly where the value is and where it is not. Close partnerships. Negotiate studio-wide deals with key players (early access, design-partner status, credits, preferential pricing) so every Hexa hardware venture starts with better conditions than it could get alone. Build the default stack. Turn what works into a reusable AI toolkit that every new Frontier Tech venture gets on day one. Design AI-native companies. Work with founders from day one on where AI sits in the product, how the business model captures value as models improve, which data to capture and own, and which workflows run on agents so the team scales without headcount growing in step with revenue. Who we’re looking for An industrial hardware engineer. 3 to 7 years designing, building and testing physical products in aerospace, defense, energy, automotive, industrial equipment or a hardware startup. You have taken parts from CAD to the shop floor and know tolerancing, DFM, test campaigns and suppliers. 100% AI-pilled. You use AI agents every day, you have built your own automations, and you have already tried text-to-CAD, AI simulation or AI electronics tools on real work. You switch setups as soon as something better ships, and you have opinions on how a hardware company should be built when much of its engineering is done by agents. A skeptical builder. You judge tools by measured time saved, not by launch videos. You are as happy killing a tool as adopting one. High agency and fast. You figure it out and ship without waiting to be told how. You are comfortable jumping between projects in the same week. Commercial sense and pedagogy. Comfortable in front of founders, engineers and vendors, able to run a workshop that turns skeptics into users, and to negotiate a partnership that actually benefits our ventures. Languages and location. Working in English, based in Paris or Brussels, with regular days physically with the founding teams. Case study: a real engineering problem from one of our ventures with Tanguy, Hexa's CTO. description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Director, International Tax 


We are looking for an Director, International Tax to build and own the international tax function at Quince. This is the first dedicated tax hire in the company, and it arrives at the moment we need it most: Quince is entering Europe, Mexico, Australia, and numerous other countries on an aggressive timeline, and every one of those markets brings tax questions we do not currently have an in-house answer to.

Entity structure. Permanent establishment. VAT and GST registration. Withholding tax. Transfer pricing. Customs and import duty treatment. Local filing obligations we may not know exist until we have already tripped over them. The International Tax Director is the person who knows where those blind spots are before we walk into them, and who tells us what we need to do about them while it is still a decision rather than a problem.

The role reports directly to the VP of Accounting and functions as their right hand on anything tax — the person who can answer any tax question, or knows exactly how to go get the answer. This role is also the first call for the Head of International on any tax question tied to a new market, and a close partner to Legal, People Ops, and Supply Chain as the international footprint is built.

Responsibilities

  •     Serve as the tax lead on every new-market launch — assess the tax profile of a market before we enter, flag what will and won't work, and define the registrations, filings, and structural decisions required to operate compliantly from day one.
  •     Build and maintain a market-entry tax playbook and a global filing calendar, so the tenth country launch is materially faster and cleaner than the first.

description: Contexte : ENSTA est un établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées. L’école a pour mission la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, dont les ingénieurs de l'armement et les ingénieurs des études et techniques de l'armement, ainsi que des cadres et docteurs hautement qualifiés pour les secteurs public et privé, en particulier dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et des technologies de pointe. ENSTA accompagne par sa recherche, son innovation et son offre de formation la transformation des grands secteurs stratégiques nationaux répondant ainsi aux enjeux de souveraineté nationale. Elle dispose de 3 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR) organisées autour de 9 laboratoires de recherche (UER) qui mènent une recherche appliquée en relation étroite avec l’industrie. ENSTA est membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris). Dans le cadre d’IP Paris, l’école participe aux activités des centres interdisciplinaires notamment du centre interdisciplinaire d'études pour la Défense et la Sécurité (CIEDS, soutenu par le ministère des armées et l’agence de l’innovation de défense (AID)). Elle est à l’origine de la création du Centre interdisciplinaire Mers & Océans, inauguré en janvier 2025. Des chercheurs de l’école travaillent également en collaboration dans le cadre d'études portées par les centres Hi-Paris, lauréat en 2024 IA Cluster, E4C ou E4H notamment. ENSTA résulte de la fusion le 1er janvier 2025 d’ENSTA Paris et d’ENSTA Bretagne. Son siège est situé à Palaiseau (91), sur le campus de Paris-Saclay et elle a un autre campus à Brest. Elle met en place une nouvelle formation d’ingénieur unifiée sur les deux campus (Paris-Saclay et Brest) à la rentrée académique 2026/2027. Rejoindre l'école, c'est intégrer un établissement engagé pour la parité et l'égalité professionnelle, la diversité et l'accompagnement de ses agents en situation de handicap, dès le recrutement et tout au long de la carrière. Afin de préserver le bien-être au travail, l'école mène une politique active en matière de conditions de travail, reposant notamment sur un juste équilibre entre vie personnelle et vie professionnelle. Sujet : “Experimental Geomechanics for Induced Seismicity and Control” Le poste fait partie du projet ERC-CdG « Preventing human-induced seismicity to fight climate change » (INJECT), financé par le Conseil européen de la recherche (ERC). La recherche sera menée à l'ENSTA, Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Le poste offre l'opportunité de travailler sur un sujet de recherche stimulant et à fort impact. Les connaissances, l'innovation et les compétences développées dans le cadre de ce poste offriront d'excellentes perspectives d'évolution de carrière tant dans l'industrie que dans le monde universitaire. Le changement climatique constitue une menace imminente pour notre civilisation. Les nouvelles technologies les plus en vue pour lutter contre le changement climatique font appel aux ressources énergétiques renouvelables et durables du sous-sol de la Terre et au stockage souterrain. Cependant, toutes ces technologies dépendent de l'injection de fluides dans la croûte terrestre, ce qui peut provoquer d'importants tremblements de terre. INJECT résoudra ce problème en s'appuyant sur une nouvelle méthode scientifique révolutionnaire qui empêchera la sismicité induite par l'homme et maximisera la production et le stockage d'énergie à partir de ressources naturelles renouvelables et durables. La méthodologie interdisciplinaire d'INJECT repose sur un programme scientifique astucieux qui place la théorie du contrôle et les mathématiques au cœur de ce nouveau défi. Sur la base de développements théoriques de pointe, des contrôleurs et des observateurs robustes seront conçus pour ajuster de manière optimale les taux d'injection de fluides, prévenir les événements sismiques induits sur de vastes régions et optimiser la production et le stockage d'énergie. Vogel berät mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen in steuerlichen, kaufmännischen und strategischen Fragen. Für dieses Netzwerk bauen wir die Event-Infrastruktur auf: Roundtables, Retreats, Salon-Formate, individuelle Mandanten-Dinner, eine laufende Webinar-Reihe, ausgewählte Messeauftritte und perspektivisch eine eigene Mittelstandskonferenz. Auch unsere internen Anlässe wie Town Hall, Sommerfest und Off-sites sollen sich anfühlen wie Vogel und nicht wie ein Standard-Firmenfest. Du kommst aus der Premium-Hospitality, aus einem gehobenen Restaurant oder von einer Event-Marke mit hohem Anspruch und willst Formate selbst entwerfen, statt fertige Konzepte umzusetzen. Du verantwortest die Event- und Brand-Experience von Vogel, arbeitest im Growth-Team und eng mit der Geschäftsführung an ausgewählten Formaten. Nach 24 bis 36 Monaten führt der natürliche Weg in eine Lead-Rolle für Event und Brand Experience. Deine Verantwortung Flagship-Anlässe und individuelle Formate Du entwirfst die Format-Bibliothek von Vogel, vom Salon über das kuratierte Dinner bis zum Retreat, und trägst jeden Anlass vom Konzept bis zum letzten Detail. Du baust die eigene Mittelstandskonferenz mit auf: Bühne, Programm, Catering, Eingangserlebnis. Du verantwortest Formate im kleinen Kreis: Mandanten-Dinner nach Branche, persönliche Termine mit Multiplikatoren, Salons mit wenigen Gästen. Laufender Betrieb: Webinare, interne Anlässe, Messen Du koordinierst die Webinar-Reihe mit zwei bis drei Terminen pro Woche: Technik, Ablaufplan, Nachbereitung und Nachverfolgung im CRM. Die Berater halten die Inhalte, du hältst den Standard. Du verantwortest den Rahmen unserer internen Anlässe auf demselben Detail-Standard wie nach außen. Du steuerst unsere Präsenz auf ausgewählten Messen, vom Standkonzept bis zum Auftritt vor Ort. Markenstandard und Abläufe Du hältst jeden Anlass gegen unser Stylebook: warme Tischkultur, reduzierte Gestaltung, echte Materialien. Du pflegst die Gästelisten mit der Geschäftsführung und dem Business Development: kuratiert, nicht im Massenversand. Du dokumentierst wiederverwendbare Standards, vom Eingangsritual bis zum Webinar-Ablauf, damit sie ohne dich tragen. Deine Perspektiven Was du nach 6 Monaten geliefert hast: Du hast die ersten Roundtables und Retreats eigenständig getragen und parallel die Webinar-Reihe übernommen. Du hast eine eigene Format-Bibliothek aufgebaut: Flagship-Formate, Webinar-Ablauf, Playbook für interne Anlässe. Was du nach 12 Monaten geliefert hast: Du trägst fünfzehn bis zwanzig Flagship-Anlässe im Jahr und die laufende Webinar-Reihe eigenständig. Was du nach 24 Monaten geliefert hast: Die eigene Mittelstandskonferenz ist gelaufen und hat einen Ruf über unsere Mandanten hinaus. Du bist Kandidat für die Lead-Rolle Event und Brand Experience. Wohin sich die Stelle entwickelt: Der nächste Schritt ist die Lead-Rolle für Event und Brand Experience. Sie setzt eine eigenständig getragene Event-Architektur und sichtbare Format-Reputation voraus, nicht zusätzliche Berufsjahre. Das bringst du mit Erfahrung & Track Record Belegbare Praxis in der Premium-Hospitality: in einer Hotelmarke mit hohem Service-Anspruch, einem gehobenen Restaurant oder bei einer Event-Marke für anspruchsvolle Gäste. Du hast neben Flagship-Anlässen auch den laufenden Betrieb in hoher Frequenz verantwortet, mit demselben Detail-Standard. Profile, die nicht in dieses Raster passen, aber Format-Gespür und Sinn für Details mitbringen, sind ausdrücklich eingeladen. Konkret: Innenarchitekten mit Praxis im Eventbau, Producer aus Magazinen mit Live-Formaten, Quereinsteiger aus Theater oder Oper. Wir bewerten am Beitrag, nicht am Etikett. Die ausgewiesene Spanne ist kein Verhandlungsspielraum, sondern eine Profil-Skala: Das untere Ende steht für belegbare Praxis in der Premium-Hospitality, das obere Ende für eigene Format-Architektur und einen erkennbaren Methodenbeitrag. Wer einen anderen Hintergrund mitbringt, startet zu einem anderen Marktpreis und konvergiert nach zwölf Monaten bewährter Leistung auf das Rollen-Niveau. Skills & Arbeitsweise Du hast Gespür für Details: Im Catering-Briefing, im Lichtkonzept oder in der Bestuhlung erkennst du, was trägt und was kippt. Du beherrschst Webinar-Werkzeuge und Ablaufplanung und löst operative Engpässe selbst, statt sie zu eskalieren. Du arbeitest mit KI als selbstverständlichem Werkzeug für Recherche, Einladungstexte und Ablaufpläne. Mindset & Persönlichkeit Du hast den Anspruch, in allem, was du ablieferst, den höchsten Standard zu setzen, nicht weil jemand es kontrolliert, sondern weil Mittelmaß dich persönlich stört. Du bringst die Demut mit, von Praktikern zu lernen. Mandanten und Berater wissen Dinge über den Mittelstand, die in keinem Hospitality-Handbuch stehen. Du fühlst dich wohl in einer Kultur, die hierarchisch in der Entscheidung, flach in der Kommunikation und autonom in der Ausführung ist. Was du bei uns nicht finden wirst Keinen Event-Job mit ausgelagerter Logistik. Du machst Konzept und Umsetzung zugleich. Kein reines Webinar-Marketing. Du verantwortest das ganze Erlebnis über alle Anlassgrößen. Keinen Agentur-Hochglanz. Wir arbeiten in kurzen Zyklen, in kleinen Teams und schrauben selbst am Detail. Keinen Aufstieg über Personalspanne. Du wächst über fachliche Tiefe. FAQ 1. Was ist Vogel – und wo arbeitet ihr? Vogel ist eine der führenden Mittelstandsberatungen Deutschlands – seit 1959, inhabergeführt in zweiter Generation, mit eigenem Kapital – und baut daraus die führende Beratungsplattform für den Mittelstand. Wir arbeiten an drei Standorten: Aalen als gewachsenem Stammsitz, Bopfingen im Kerngeschäft und München als neuem Hub. An allen dreien suchen wir quer durch die Funktionen – von Steuerberatung über Beratung bis zu den Teams, die das Fundament darunter bauen. 2. Wie sind die Gehaltsbänder zu verstehen? Bewusst breit – und an jeder Stelle ausgewiesen, bevor du dich bewirbst. Wir differenzieren nach Track Record und Marktwert, nicht nach Abschluss: knappe, stark gefragte Profile am oberen Ende, weniger knappe am unteren. Die ausgewiesene Spanne ist kein Verhandlungsspielraum, sondern eine Profil-Skala – zwei Menschen mit ähnlicher Erfahrung können bei uns unterschiedlich verdienen. Was das obere Ende bestimmt, ist der Reifegrad, nicht die Zahl der Berufsjahre und nicht das Verhandlungsgeschick. 3. Wie viel – und wie – wird bei Vogel gearbeitet? Gemessen wird an dem, was du bewegst, nicht an Stunden. Ehrlich ist aber auch: Wer 9-to-5 sucht, ist bei uns nicht die erste Adresse. Wir suchen Menschen, die aus eigenem Antrieb intensiv arbeiten, weil die Aufgaben es wert sind. Wie du deine Zeit verteilst, ist weitgehend deine Sache. Was wir teilen: Wir arbeiten präsent zusammen und sehen uns im Normalfall täglich im Büro – Kultur, Sparring und die besten Ideen entstehen in der täglichen Nähe. Wir sind keine Remote-Company und haben keine großen Home-Office-Policies; einzelne Remote-Tage sind kein Problem. 4. Wie läuft die Bewerbung? Schlank, schnell, transparent – und nach Profil gestaffelt. In der Regel sind es vier Schritte: eine schriftliche Aufgabe, in der du zu acht Fragen Position beziehst – KI ist ausdrücklich erlaubt, wir bitten nur um eine kurze Selbstauskunft dazu; ein Gespräch von einer halben Stunde; eine gemeinsame Arbeitssitzung an einem echten Problem aus unserem Alltag; und ein Termin vor Ort mit dem Team und gemeinsamem Essen. Wie viele Schritte es tatsächlich werden, hängt von der Rolle ab: Bei Praktikum und Werkstudium fällt der Vor-Ort-Termin weg, für Schülerjobs genügt ein Gespräch, bei Senior-Rollen kommt ein gemeinsamer Arbeitsnachmittag dazu. Vorab kannst du einen Zehn-Minuten-Call buchen, in dem nur du fragst. In der Regel hörst du nach jedem Schritt innerhalb von 48 Stunden von uns. 5. Wie funktioniert die variable Vergütung? Quartalsweise an Leistung gekoppelt, qualitativ bewertet. Die Skala steigt mit dem Level: bis 20 % Associate, 27,5 % Manager, 35 % Senior Manager, 42,5 % Director, 50 % VP. Erwartungswert bei guter Leistung – du erfüllst die Anforderungen, setzt eigene Akzente, bestehst den Keeper Test – liegt bei rund 50 % des Maximums; der Maximalbonus ist nicht der Normalfall. Im Fokus steht eine ganzheitliche Beurteilung durch deine Führungskraft anhand von sechs Kriterien: Impact, Judgement, Communication, Execution, Growth und Values. 6. Wie entwickle ich mich – welche Karrierewege gibt es? Zwei aktive Wege: die IC-Karriere (fachliche Tiefe, Expertenlaufbahn) über die Stufen Expert, Senior, Lead und Principal – und die Management-Karriere (Führung, Personalverantwortung) über Manager, Senior Manager, Director und VP. Beide werden gleich vergütet, und beide müssen nicht nach oben führen: Wer auf einer Stufe bleibt und dort weiter in die Tiefe geht, ist bei uns genauso richtig. Die Richtung wählst du nach dem Onboarding, meist in Jahr 1–3. Berufseinstieg ist kein Sonderweg, sondern der frühe Teil derselben Strecke – vom Werkstudenten oder Praktikanten zum Associate, für die Besten ohne erneutes Bewerbungsverfahren. 7. Team, Kultur, Urlaub? Das gemeinsame Mittagessen ist der tägliche Ankerpunkt – wer im Büro ist, isst mit; erwartet, nicht kontrolliert. Das Abendessen ist dasselbe Angebot ohne jede Erwartung. Beides ohne Eigenanteil. Dazu Social Events und Offsites in regelmäßigem Rhythmus – nicht als Pflichtprogramm, sondern weil ein gutes Team auch abseits der Arbeit Zeit teilt. Benefits sind bei uns nicht das Sahnehäubchen, sondern das, was Intensität über Jahre tragbar macht: Examensförderung mit 25.000 EUR Qualifizierungsbudget und drei Monaten Freistellung, 100-prozentige Übernahme der Kinderbetreuung, EGYM Wellpass, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Job-Ticket mit 90 % Zuschuss, Homeoffice-Ausstattung und ein Gerät deiner Wahl aus unserem Katalog, ein Buch im Monat aus dem Vogel-Kanon – und KI-Tools ohne Token-Limit und ohne Budgetdeckel. description:
About Pallet

Pallet is building AI Agents to transform the physical economy, a $12 trillion global TAM. We’ve raised $50M from top investors, including General Catalyst, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Bain Capital Ventures. 

Our mission is to increase the efficiency of the global supply chain by automating the manual workflows that slow supply chain teams down. Our flagship platform provides end-to-end visibility, and control.

As companies across the physical economy look to drive efficiency, many are turning to Pallet to lead the way. With deep supply chain expertise and cutting-edge AI capabilities, we’re positioned to build the next $10B company powering the physical economy.

Join us and work alongside leaders from Google, DoorDash, YC, and more to shape the future of supply chain technology.

Remote from Switzerland

You could be an Enterprise Account Executive anywhere. Why us?

  • Join a well-funded, high-growth startup on a clear path to $100M ARR.
  • Sell a category-defining AI Agents platform with massive surface area across logistics.
  • Build Pallet’s presence across Europe as one of the first commercial hires on the ground.
  • Work directly with founders and senior leadership to define our international go-to-market strategy.
  • Help transform one of the world’s largest industries while building toward a $10B+ outcome.

About the opportunity

We’re hiring our first Founding Enterprise Account Executives in EMEA to build Pallet’s commercial presence across Europe.

You’ll own net-new enterprise acquisition across the region, build relationships with the largest logistics providers in Europe, and help establish the playbook for our international expansion. This is a highly consultative enterprise sales role focused on educating customers on an entirely new category of AI-powered workflow automation.

You’ll partner closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Solutions, and Customer Success to drive a solution-selling motion centered around workflow discovery, AI use case identification, structured pilots, and measurable ROI.

This role will be remote from Switzerland. 

How you will make an impact

  • Own the full enterprise sales cycle across EMEA, from outbound prospecting through contract signature.
  • Build and maintain a 3x-4x qualified pipeline through disciplined outbound execution while self-sourcing at least 30% of opportunities.
  • Develop relationships with executive stakeholders across Europe’s largest logistics providers, including COO, CIO, VP Operations, VP Supply Chain, and VP Technology.
  • Lead consultative discovery sessions that map operational workflows to Pallet’s AI agent capabilities.
  • Scope and lead structured pilots that demonstrate measurable operational ROI and convert into enterprise deployments.
  • Build executive business cases that align operational improvements with financial outcomes.
  • Document repeatable customer use cases and market feedback to shape Pallet’s product roadmap and international GTM strategy.
  • Help establish Pallet as the leading AI platform for enterprise logistics across Europe.

What we’re looking for

  • 8+ years of enterprise B2B SaaS or enterprise logistics sales experience.
  • Business-fluent German: you can run discovery, negotiate and present to executives in German. 
  • Proven track record of consistently closing six- and seven-figure enterprise software agreements.
  • Strong consultative selling and value-based sales methodology.
  • Experience navigating complex buying committees and long enterprise sales cycles.
  • Executive presence with senior operators and technology leaders.
  • Comfortable selling technical, workflow-heavy software products.
  • Ability to quickly understand complex logistics operations and translate them into compelling AI automation opportunities.
  • Excellent outbound prospecting and territory-building discipline.
  • Willingness to travel extensively across Europe.

Experience selling into logistics, supply chain, transportation, or warehouse operations is strongly preferred but not required. Candidates without logistics experience should demonstrate an ability to quickly learn operational workflows and become trusted advisors to customers.

Working model

Working hours are generally 9:00am-6:00pm London time, providing full coverage of the European business day while maintaining regular collaboration with our San Francisco headquarters.

You’ll typically spend:

  • Mornings and early afternoons working directly with European customers and prospects.
  • Late afternoons collaborating with our US-based Sales, Product, and Engineering teams during our daily overlap window.
  • Approximately 65% of your time traveling across Europe for customer meetings, executive workshops, pilots, and industry events.

Reporting structure

You’ll report directly to our VP of Global Revenue, for territory strategy, customer relationships, and international expansion and will participate in weekly pipeline reviews, forecasting, and sales process alignment with the US team.

Interview Process

  • Chat with Christy - Business Recruiter - 30 mins
  • Deal Review - 30 mins
  • Discovery Mock Interview - 45-60 mins
  • Final Interview - ~2.5 hours
  • Brief Background Check and Reference Check

We move fast, and we’ll keep you informed at every stage of the process.

Compensation

The estimated compensation range for this role is 280-340k CHF OTE, 50/50 split, depending on experience and skill set.

Our compensation follows a standard 50/50 enterprise sales structure consisting of base salary and target commission. High performers are eligible for uncapped commission accelerators above quota.

In addition to cash compensation, we offer competitive equity, benefits, and significant growth opportunities as one of our earliest international commercial hires.

Final compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and demonstrated enterprise sales performance.

 

Our Benefits 

We invest in our people the same way we invest in our product: seriously.

  • 🩺 Health, Vision, and Dental benefits 
  • 🏝️ Take-what-you-need Paid Vacation
  • ➕ Life Insurance and Accidental Insurance 
  • ❤️‍🩹 Short-Term Disability Coverage
  • 💸 Generous salary and equity for all staff
  • 🪜 401k option; helping you save for the future
  • 🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Paid parental leave to support growing families
  • 📚 Yearly learning and development stipend
  • 🚌 Commuter benefits for Bay Area and New York employees
  • 🚘 Uber ride stipend if you ever have to work late in the office 
  • 🏡 Remote office home stipend to get you comfy in your space for remote employees
  •  📸 Free professional headshot 
  • 🍔 Daily catered lunches and dinners provided in office
  • 💪 Complimentary On-Site Gym: Our SF office has a fully equipped gym 
  • ✈️ Onboarding trip to one of our offices if you work remotely
  • 🥤 Monthly happy hours
  • 🎉 Annual Company Offsites; our last one was in Palm Springs CA 🌴

Workplace Policy

We are an in-person company. Our offices in San Francisco, New York City and London are where ideas get built, decisions get made, and the team gets stronger. We have invested in making them genuinely great places to spend your day, with catered lunches, monthly happy hours, and people who care about the work and each other.

Most of our team works in office five days a week. For select roles, we hire remotely across the U.S. Remote employees come to one of our offices for their first week to onboard and meet the team, and we cover the full trip. 

Every role is different. Travel expectations are always shared upfront in the job description and confirmed in your first call with us.

Equal Opportunity

Pallet is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We make all employment decisions based solely on merit. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without discrimination on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, disability status, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic. We prohibit any form of discrimination or harassment. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including hiring.

Candidate Privacy Notice

Please review Pallet’s Candidate Privacy Notice here.

Accommodations

Pallet complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), as amended by the ADA Amendments Act, and all applicable state or local laws. We will reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with a disability during the application process and throughout employment as required by law.

If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please contact us at

description: about us Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world. For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses. AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years. At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it. We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture. Check out our principles to see how we work. Your mission telli is arriving in France. We are building a small, mighty team in Paris to make every customer interaction worth having. We have a product already used by leading B2C businesses, but the French market is still at the beginning. We will earn our place, one customer at a time. We are outbound first. As a founding Enterprise Account Executive, you will create opportunities, win major French accounts, and help define how telli sells in this market. You will carry a quota and own the hard parts of the deal, from the first cold conversation to signature. Your work will shape the playbook for the team that follows. What you'll do Build your own enterprise pipeline through thoughtful outbound, calls, referrals, and a deep understanding of French customer operations. Lead complex sales cycles end to end: discovery, demos, business cases, executive alignment, security, legal, procurement, and negotiation. Find the real problem behind a customer's interest in AI, quantify the value of solving it, and earn trust across the buying group. Work closely with the France team, founders, product, and deployment colleagues to turn early customers into lasting successes. Keep an honest forecast and turn wins, losses, and objections into a repeatable French sales motion. What makes you a great fit You have personally sourced and closed complex B2B enterprise deals, ideally in software or AI, and can show how you earned them. You are comfortable speaking with senior business leaders and working through IT, security, finance, legal, and procurement. You enjoy the unglamorous work as much as the big meeting: prospecting, follow-up, and fixing what is broken. You bring a bias for action, aim for excellence, take ownership, and work with low ego. Read the telli principles You communicate with confidence and care in French and can work effectively in English with our international team. You are based in Paris and can spend two weeks in Berlin for onboarding. You are ready to travel and visit prospects across France when needed. You may not be a good fit if You don't believe voice is the future of how people and businesses talk to each other. You expect a ready-made book of business or marketing to build your pipeline. You want to join deals only after discovery, and avoid cold outreach or the hard follow-through between meetings. You need a fixed playbook before acting or pass on ownership when a deal gets messy. You dislike working across executive, operations, IT, legal, and procurement stakeholders or learning openly from losses. The reality of the role France is a new market for us. There is no mature local playbook or book of business waiting for you. Some deals will be messy, and you will need to create momentum yourself. If you want ownership, direct feedback, ambitious colleagues, and the chance to do the best work of your career, this is the opportunity. The hiring process The hiring process itself is a case study in how you sell. Approach it as you would a complex account: research us, form a point of view, earn attention, ask and listen, follow through, and respond to feedback. We will evaluate how you create momentum and manage the process end to end, with the judgment and ownership you would bring to winning enterprise customers in France. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years. At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it. We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture. Check out our principles to see how we work. Your mission telli is arriving in France. We are building a small, mighty team in Paris to make every customer interaction worth having. The product is real; the French playbook is still being written. We are outsiders here, and we will earn our place through better conversations, sharper execution, and customers who see the difference. We are outbound first. As our founding BDR in France, you will start conversations rather than wait for them. You will find the right companies, reach the people who own customer operations, and create qualified opportunities for the team. You will also help decide which messages, channels, and routines deserve to become our French sales playbook. What you'll do Build targeted account lists and find the people with a real customer interaction problem to solve. Prospect every day through calls, email, LinkedIn, and thoughtful experiments. The phone is a core part of this role. Run sharp first conversations: understand the workflow, volume, owner, urgency, and reason to act; then hand over opportunities with context the AE can use. Test messages and sequences, measure what turns into useful conversations and qualified pipeline, and improve quickly. Bring what prospects say back to the France team, product, and marketing, and use those insights to improve targeting and messaging. What makes you a great fit You do not need sales experience. Your background could be the military, firefighting, competitive sport, or something else entirely. What matters is your discipline, coachability, rigor, and ability to keep going through rejection. description: About Grubel Grubel is a research lab that builds AI for high-stakes knowledge work, starting with law. Legal matters require specialized expertise, and each one involves its own facts, practices, parties, and institutions. General-purpose AI applies the same system to every legal matter, varying only what goes into a limited context window. To meet the depth and diversity of legal work, we let every matter build its own AI: engineer the right data for the matter, adapt the model and agent to it, and track what improves. We combine the three into a matter-specific improvement loop that runs until the system delivers what the matter demands. description: Méthodes numériques et d’intelligence artificielle combinée à une approche expérimentale pour concevoir des matériaux et dispositifs de stockage de l’énergie à partir de composites biocarbone à base de graphite. ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE : École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation. Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être. IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient. Le poste est à pourvoir au sein du Centre RAPSODEE (Recherche d'Albi en génie des Procédés des SOlides Divisés, de l'Energie et de l'Environnement), unité mixte de recherche CNRS dédiée aux procédés, matériaux et énergies durables. Le Postdoc sera dirigé par le professeur Ange Nzihou et codirigé par un chercheur de l'université de Princeton (États-Unis). DESCRIPTION DU POSTE : Ce travail s’inscrit dans un projet ERC (European Research Council) Advanced Grant. L’ERC est une organisation européenne de financement qui soutient des projets de recherche de rupture à travers des appels à projets très compétitifs, dans le cadre du programme Horizon Europe de l’Union européenne. Le projet ERC vise à évaluer la capacité de stockage de composites innovants en biocarbones. Il s’agit d’une famille de matériaux carbonés avancés et durables issus de la biomasse, permettant de stocker l’énergie dans différents environnements, contrairement à la plupart des solutions actuelles reposant sur des matériaux d’origine fossile ou non durables. Cela devrait se traduire par une réduction notable des émissions de CO₂ et des économies d’énergie. Les travaux seront menés dans un environnement international, avec des visites régulières dans les laboratoires de partenaires en France, en Inde et aux États-Unis. Nous recherchons un chercheur ou une chercheuse très motivé(e) pour contribuer à la conception et au développement de matériaux et de dispositifs de stockage de l’énergie avancés et performants, en combinant des méthodes de calcul, l’intelligence artificielle (IA) et des approches expérimentales. L’objectif est de développer et d’appliquer des modèles numériques, des méthodes fondées sur les données et des outils utilisant l’IA afin de prédire les propriétés des matériaux, d’optimiser leur composition et leur structure, et d’améliorer la capacité et les performances de stockage de l’énergie. Les travaux combineront des études théoriques et numériques avec la synthèse expérimentale, la caractérisation, la validation et l’optimisation de solutions innovantes de stockage de l’énergie. Un axe important du projet portera sur l’étude des propriétés thermophysiques, thermomécaniques et de stabilité thermique de composites à base de biocarbone graphitique. Le/La candidat(e) étudiera les relations entre la structure des matériaux, leurs propriétés fonctionnelles, leur comportement et les performances globales du dispositif en conditions d’utilisation, afin de contribuer au développement de technologies de stockage de l’énergie sûres, efficaces et durables. Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables : • Solides compétences en sciences computationnelles, en méthodes apprentissage automatique (machine learning) et en méthodes fondées sur l’intelligence artificielle • Solides compétences en caractérisation des matériaux, en recherche expérimentale et dans les technologies de stockage de l’énergie • Bonnes compétences en programmation Capacités et aptitudes : • Rigueur scientifique, capacité d’analyse et de synthèse • Autonomie et esprit d’initiative • Capacité à travailler dans un environnement de recherche international et interdisciplinaire • Bonne communication écrite et orale en anglais PROFIL RECHERCHE : Diplôme de doctorat (PhD) en génie des procédés, science des matériaux, génie énergétique, physique, sciences computationnelles ou dans un domaine connexe. Vogel ist eine der führenden Mittelstandsberatungen Deutschlands – seit 1959, inhabergeführt in zweiter Generation, mit eigenem Kapital – und baut daraus die führende Beratungsplattform für den Mittelstand. Wir arbeiten an drei Standorten: Aalen als gewachsenem Stammsitz, Bopfingen im Kerngeschäft und München als neuem Hub. An allen dreien suchen wir quer durch die Funktionen – von Steuerberatung über Beratung bis zu den Teams, die das Fundament darunter bauen. 2. Wie sind die Gehaltsbänder zu verstehen? Bewusst breit – und an jeder Stelle ausgewiesen, bevor du dich bewirbst. Wir differenzieren nach Track Record und Marktwert, nicht nach Abschluss: knappe, stark gefragte Profile am oberen Ende, weniger knappe am unteren. Die ausgewiesene Spanne ist kein Verhandlungsspielraum, sondern eine Profil-Skala – zwei Menschen mit ähnlicher Erfahrung können bei uns unterschiedlich verdienen. Was das obere Ende bestimmt, ist der Reifegrad, nicht die Zahl der Berufsjahre und nicht das Verhandlungsgeschick. 3. Wie viel – und wie – wird bei Vogel gearbeitet? Gemessen wird an dem, was du bewegst, nicht an Stunden. Ehrlich ist aber auch: Wer 9-to-5 sucht, ist bei uns nicht die erste Adresse. Wir suchen Menschen, die aus eigenem Antrieb intensiv arbeiten, weil die Aufgaben es wert sind. Wie du deine Zeit verteilst, ist weitgehend deine Sache. Was wir teilen: Wir arbeiten präsent zusammen und sehen uns im Normalfall täglich im Büro – Kultur, Sparring und die besten Ideen entstehen in der täglichen Nähe. Wir sind keine Remote-Company und haben keine großen Home-Office-Policies; einzelne Remote-Tage sind kein Problem. 4. Wie läuft die Bewerbung? Schlank, schnell, transparent – und nach Profil gestaffelt. In der Regel sind es vier Schritte: eine schriftliche Aufgabe, in der du zu acht Fragen Position beziehst – KI ist ausdrücklich erlaubt, wir bitten nur um eine kurze Selbstauskunft dazu; ein Gespräch von einer halben Stunde; eine gemeinsame Arbeitssitzung an einem echten Problem aus unserem Alltag; und ein Termin vor Ort mit dem Team und gemeinsamem Essen. Wie viele Schritte es tatsächlich werden, hängt von der Rolle ab: Bei Praktikum und Werkstudium fällt der Vor-Ort-Termin weg, für Schülerjobs genügt ein Gespräch, bei Senior-Rollen kommt ein gemeinsamer Arbeitsnachmittag dazu. Vorab kannst du einen Zehn-Minuten-Call buchen, in dem nur du fragst. In der Regel hörst du nach jedem Schritt innerhalb von 48 Stunden von uns. 5. Wie funktioniert die variable Vergütung? Quartalsweise an Leistung gekoppelt, qualitativ bewertet. Die Skala steigt mit dem Level: bis 20 % Associate, 27,5 % Manager, 35 % Senior Manager, 42,5 % Director, 50 % VP. Erwartungswert bei guter Leistung – du erfüllst die Anforderungen, setzt eigene Akzente, bestehst den Keeper Test – liegt bei rund 50 % des Maximums; der Maximalbonus ist nicht der Normalfall. Im Fokus steht eine ganzheitliche Beurteilung durch deine Führungskraft anhand von sechs Kriterien: Impact, Judgement, Communication, Execution, Growth und Values. 6. Wie entwickle ich mich – welche Karrierewege gibt es? Zwei aktive Wege: die IC-Karriere (fachliche Tiefe, Expertenlaufbahn) über die Stufen Expert, Senior, Lead und Principal – und die Management-Karriere (Führung, Personalverantwortung) über Manager, Senior Manager, Director und VP. Beide werden gleich vergütet, und beide müssen nicht nach oben führen: Wer auf einer Stufe bleibt und dort weiter in die Tiefe geht, ist bei uns genauso richtig. Die Richtung wählst du nach dem Onboarding, meist in Jahr 1–3. Berufseinstieg ist kein Sonderweg, sondern der frühe Teil derselben Strecke – vom Werkstudenten oder Praktikanten zum Associate, für die Besten ohne erneutes Bewerbungsverfahren. 7. Team, Kultur, Urlaub? Das gemeinsame Mittagessen ist der tägliche Ankerpunkt – wer im Büro ist, isst mit; erwartet, nicht kontrolliert. Das Abendessen ist dasselbe Angebot ohne jede Erwartung. Beides ohne Eigenanteil. Dazu Social Events und Offsites in regelmäßigem Rhythmus – nicht als Pflichtprogramm, sondern weil ein gutes Team auch abseits der Arbeit Zeit teilt. Benefits sind bei uns nicht das Sahnehäubchen, sondern das, was Intensität über Jahre tragbar macht: Examensförderung mit 25.000 EUR Qualifizierungsbudget und drei Monaten Freistellung, 100-prozentige Übernahme der Kinderbetreuung, EGYM Wellpass, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Job-Ticket mit 90 % Zuschuss, Homeoffice-Ausstattung und ein Gerät deiner Wahl aus unserem Katalog, ein Buch im Monat aus dem Vogel-Kanon – und KI-Tools ohne Token-Limit und ohne Budgetdeckel. description:
About the position

We’re looking for compiler engineers to join a new ML Compilers Team at Jane Street. 

Machine learning is a critical pillar of our global business. Our ever-evolving trading environment serves as a unique, rapid-feedback platform for ML experimentation, allowing us to incorporate new ideas with relatively little friction. Our ML team is full of people with a shared love for the craft of software engineering, and for designing APIs and systems that are delightful to use.

ML compilers let us quickly turn research ideas and novel architectures into high-throughput training jobs and low-latency inference. To get the most out of our hardware resources and enable rapid model development and deployment, we are working to understand and improve the current ML compiler technologies and explore where it makes sense to build our own solutions. In this role, you would shape the development of our compiler stack.

If you’ve never thought about a career in finance, you’re in good company. Many of us were in the same position before working here. If you have a curious mind and a passion for solving interesting problems, we have a feeling you’ll fit right in.

About you

The ideal candidate has worked on an ML compiler in the past, but non-ML compiler experience is also valuable. Experience with any part of the stack is fine, be it high-level ML frameworks (PyTorch, Jax, TensorFlow), graph compilers (Inductor, XLA, TVM) or kernel DSLs (Triton, Helion, cuTile). You should understand how all those pieces fit together even if you are unfamiliar with specific parts. 

Some other things you might be excited about are:

  • Optimisations in ML compilers: algebraic rewriting, materialise vs recompute tradeoffs and fusion, equality saturation, scheduling languages, loop-level optimisation, autotuning
  • ML compiler frontends: graph capture, symbolic and dynamic shapes, control flow, automatic differentiation
  • GPU kernel programming and architecture: Triton, cuTile, CuTeDSL, CUDA, compute and memory hierarchies, programming with tensor cores
  • Compiler concepts: static analysis, intermediate representations like SSA and CFGs, instruction selection
  • ML inference: CUDA Graphs, KV caching, batching
  • ML training: Tensor/Sequence/Expert/Pipeline Parallelism, FSDP, NCCL, activation checkpointing
  • GPU debugging and optimisation: CUDA-GDB, Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute
  • Formal methods: proof assistants, automated theorem provers, agentic proof systems
  • Programming languages and DSL design: embedded DSLs, staging and metaprogramming, type systems, functional programming
  • Fluency in English is required

description: Role summary: At Differential Bio, our mission is to unlock the potential of the bioeconomy by fixing how biological R&D and scale-up are done. We’re looking for a Machine Learning Data Scientist to join our growing cutting-edge modelling team. You will develop novel machine learning algorithms and mechanistic models of bioprocess systems and push them from research proof-of-concept into production-ready commercial use. This role is focused on research, including creating hybrid models that combine mechanistic and machine learning approaches to predict how microbial fermentations behave, and that keep working when we move to a new organism, a new sensor, or a larger reactor. You’ll play an instrumental role on two existing grants and work with leading academic groups and industrial partners on pilot- and production-scale data. In addition, you’ll develop new research projects and drive them to completion and application on customer projects. We’re interested in researchers who want their work to end up in real bioreactors and are excited about working at an early-stage startup. You should be comfortable owning hard, open-ended problems where nobody has the answer yet, making evidence-based decisions under uncertainty, and shipping real solutions. How you’ll work You’ll collaborate with technical leads and academic/industry external partners to design and execute research that meets our commitments in both consortia and strengthens our own platform. You’ll own your research projects from scoping to delivery, with support from our modelling lead but with autonomy and independence. You’ll work closely with our wet lab, dry lab and software teams, and identify which data you need to generate from our robotic lab. Key responsibilities: Hybrid bioprocess modelling Develop hybrid mechanistic/ML cell response models that predict fermentation outcomes (growth, titer, yield, productivity) from process and sensor data. Fuse time-series signals from process analytical technology (Raman, NIR, dielectric spectroscopy, dissolved oxygen, off-gas) with offline analytics. Build mechanistic backbones (e.g., kinetic/ODE models, genome-scale metabolic models) that constrain learning and generate synthetic training data. Develop machine learning surrogate models for computationally costly mechanistic simulations. Quantify uncertainty so that models can be trusted in high-stakes production settings. Transfer across organisms and scales Design models that carry over from benchtop to pilot and production scale, and across various microbes including bacteria and yeast. Use transfer learning and representation learning to make good predictions for new strains and processes with little data. Develop scale-transferable reactor characterisations and predictive KPI models for scale-up. Real-time Model-Predictive Control Build the AI/ML layer for Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC) and reinforcement-learning-based feeding strategies to optimize titer, rate, and yield dynamically. Fuse real-time data from Process Analytical Technology (PAT) and soft sensors (e.g., Raman, NIR) into dynamic state estimators to drive closed-loop bioreactor actuators (feed, air, agitation). Prototype simpler, deployable steps along the way, such as deviation detection and operator alerts Design control frameworks to proactively resolve metabolic bottlenecks and robustly account for model uncertainty, batch-to-batch variability, and inherent bioprocess stochasticity. Qualifications: PhD in machine learning, bioengineering, computational biology, or a related field, or a Master’s degree with 3+ years of relevant industry experience. Strong research independence; ability to scope and execute novel scientific work from start to finish. Demonstrated evidence of research contributions, including (but not limited to): peer-reviewed journal or conference papers, conference attendance, open-source contributions. Strong Python and modern ML tooling (e.g., PyTorch/JAX, scikit-learn). Hands-on experience building models of dynamical systems or time-series data, ideally combining mechanistic and data-driven approaches. Experience working with frontier coding models, including multi-agent orchestration. Clear written and verbal communication, including with non-ML partners. Nice-to-have: Experience with bioprocess or fermentation data, ideally from bioreactors at more than one scale Experience with Raman, NIR, or other spectroscopic data and chemometrics (e.g., PLS) Background in model-predictive control, reinforcement learning, or optimal control Experience with transfer learning, domain adaptation, or representation learning on biological data Familiarity with genome-scale metabolic models or kinetic modelling Experience with Bayesian methods, uncertainty quantification, or design of experiments Experience in collaborative or publicly funded research projects (e.g. Horizon Europe, Eurostars) Benefits: Competitive compensation through salary + stock options; we are looking to build a small but mighty team and think about compensation along those lines; Build your research profile: Work on open problems with leading European academic and industrial partners, with the intention to present and publish your work; A beautiful office in the heart of Munich, or remote work option with occasional travel eGym WellPass membership Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description:
The Role

Join the UK’s market leading Financial Advisory Restructuring Tax team and make a real difference on a range of high profile and dynamic transactions. Our Financial Advisory Restructuring Tax team specialises in providing tax advice on the restructuring of financially distressed businesses. They have built a fantastic track record in recent years, leading on some of Europe’s largest and most complex restructuring processes. These include debt restructuring transactions, debt-for-equity swaps, business reconstructions via Restructuring Plans, Schemes of Arrangement and CVAs, and insolvency appointments. The variety of work really stands out, as does the friendly and supportive nature of the team. The team has a great mix of UK and international transactions work and is looking to recruit a corporation tax specialist at Associate Director level to build on the existing business capability and target a number of exciting developments in the restructuring market. This role is primarily advisory focused but will have some compliance responsibility. This is a unique opportunity to get involved. The role is technically interesting and personally rewarding.

Key Responsibilities

Your key areas of focus will include:

  • Working directly with our financial advisory colleagues and external stakeholders including lenders, borrowers and legal advisors to understand the often complex commercial and legal requirements of each restructuring transaction;
  • Developing a strategy for achieving the commercial aims in a tax efficient manner.
  • Reviewing and preparing reports setting out the steps necessary to meet the aims of the transaction;
  • Advising insolvency practitioners involved in the restructuring on the tax consequences of their intended actions;
  • Advising on the submission of appropriate tax returns or other documentation to tax authorities and liaising with them, as required;
  • Supporting the business development activities of the team (you will have a broad scope to build relationships both internally and with key clients); and
  • Contributing to the technical and personal development training of the broader team.

Key Skills & Experience

To qualify for the role you must have:

  • ACA/CTA or equivalent qualification or experience;
  • Strong UK tax technical skills;
  • Strong communication, team playing and project management skills;  and
  • The ability to perform strongly under pressure.

Prior experience of transactions or insolvency processes is preferred.

What can we offer you?

New joiners are supported by a week-long induction programme, and continuous improvement is achieved through a structured and tailored programme that suits your career development.

As well as this we offer a whole host of benefits and reward including:

  • Competitive Salary
  • 28 days holiday
  • Discretionary Bonus Scheme
  • Cash benefits allowance
  • Company pension scheme
  • Extensive investment in personal development & learning
  • Enhanced maternity and paternity leave (depending on length of service) and shared parental leave
  • Group Income protection
  • Life assurance
  • Cycle to work schemes
  • Regular social, cultural and charitable activities

About Teneo

Teneo is the global CEO advisory firm. We partner with our clients globally to do great things for a better future.

Drawing upon our global team and expansive network of senior advisors, we provide advisory services across our five business segments on a stand-alone or fully integrated basis to help our clients solve complex business challenges. Our clients include a significant number of the Fortune 100 and FTSE 100, as well as other corporations, financial institutions, and organizations.

Our full range of advisory services includes strategic communications, investor relations, financial transactions and restructuring, management consulting, physical and cyber risk, organizational design, board and executive search, geopolitics and government affairs, corporate governance, ESG and DE&I.

The firm has more than 1,800 employees located in 40+ offices around the world.

description:
Our mission

Constructor’s mission is to enable all educational organisations to provide high-quality digital education to 10x people with 10x efficiency. 

With strong expertise in machine intelligence and data science, Constructor’s all-in-one platform for education and research addresses today’s pressing educational challenges: access inequality, tech clutter, and low engagement of students.

Please send your resume in English only.

Interns are NOT eligible for equipment and other benefits as the position is temporary.

The Reality

The frontier models are converging into commodities; the engine is no longer the differentiator. The scarcity in 2026 is not the model.

We are not looking for people to fine-tune Llama on toy datasets or write "better prompts." We are building the runtime systems that turn probabilistic token generation into reliable workers that finish 50-step tasks without spiraling. We are solving the math of multi-step reliability through engineering, not wishful thinking.

What You Will Solve

You will work on the Agentic Harness, treating the LLM as a component within a larger, deterministic control system. Your research will focus on:

  • Architecting loops that survive error accumulation. You will build verification layers that force the agent to recognize its own hallucinations and self-correct.
  • You will implement systems where the agent compiles its own constraints and the harness enforces them via constrained decoding or external execution.
  • You will optimise KV-cache hit rates and design "restorable compression" strategies to prevent attention decay.

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for systems thinkers who happen to know ML, not the other way around.

  • You know that a demo is not a product. You are interested in the "boring" engineering: state machines, retries, idempotency, serialisation — that actually makes agents work.
  • You are comfortable working with the raw output of the model and building robust software in Python or Rust around it.
  • You understand why dynamic tool loading destroys inference economics. You prefer deterministic guardrails over "prompting it to be nicer."
  • You are willing to read a 500-line trace of a failed agent loop to find the exact moment the context drifted. You care about the "last mile" of reliability.

  • Type of internship:
    • 100% remote
    • or hybrid in the office in Bremen (GER), Sofia (BG), Belgrade (SRB), Istanbul (TR), Sakarya (TR), Singapore (SGD)
