description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We’re looking for a Security Product Manager to join our team. Security Product Manager is responsible for conveying the company’s security strengths to customers, partners and the market at large. This includes participating in relevant security partnership initiatives, influencing security positioning and branding, and working closely with internal teams to ensure company’s security posture and security products is communicated effectively to all stakeholders. By combining expertise in compliance requirements with a customer-centric approach, Security Product Manager helps position security as a competitive advantage rather than just an internal obligation. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

1. Product Management 

  • Define the vision and roadmap for Nebius’ security products. 
  • Owning the ideation, postmortem, prioritization, backlog, and customer feedback processes. 
  • Guiding new features, systems and services from inception to launch, while keeping customers at the center of everything. 

2. Customer-facing communications 

  • Lead public-facing communications around security updates or changes in compliance status. 
  • In the event of a security incident, coordinate user messaging (email notifications, press releases, FAQs) with support from the Head of Security Products and CISO. 
  • Gather user feedback on user experience and security to guide continuous improvements. 

 3. Competitive analysis and market research 

  • Conduct ongoing research on industry benchmarks, emerging security standards and technologies, and competitor certifications. 
  • Identify gaps and opportunities in organization’s product security posture; propose strategic initiatives that differentiate the company’s security story in the market. 
  • Stay informed about new regulations or frameworks that may influence future product certifications or transparency requirements (e.g., privacy laws, data sovereignty standards). 

 4. Certification and audit support, service ownership 

  • Collaborate with the CISO office to gather technical evidence or make necessary product enhancements that satisfy certification requirements. 
  • Take ownership of some security-related services of Cloud platform. 
  • Track and maintain a certification roadmap (ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPPA, etc.), working closely with CISO, GRC & Compliance, Corporate Security departments. Communicate timelines, goals and status updates to leadership and sales representatives. 

5. Cross-functional collaboration 

  • Coordinate with multiple Product Managers to align security goals with other product roadmaps, ensuring a consistent narrative between product security and external messaging. 
  • Work with Platform Security, GRC & Corporate Security and legal teams to gather essential information for security products enhancements (e.g., penetration test summaries, compliance reports). 
  • Work with Customer-facing teams to address client inquiries about security posture and guide them on using security features optimally. 

We expect you to have: 

  • 3+ years of Product Management or Program Management experience with a focus on security initiatives. 
  • Basic knowledge of compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR) and familiarity with how they translate into business value. 
  • Proven ability to communicate technical concepts in a clear, customer-friendly manner (e.g., writing content, speaking at webinars or conferences). 
  • Stakeholder management skills to align with other Product Managers, CISO staff, engineering, marketing, and customer-facing teams. 
  • Analytical mindset: comfortable defining success metrics (e.g., security feature adoption, NPS around trust, certification progress) and making data-driven decisions. 
  • Project management skills: demonstrated ability to manage inter-team collaboration within company-wide projects, ensuring timely delivery of cross-functional tasks and alignment with compliance goals. 

It will be an added bonus if you have: 

  •  Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or PMP; prior experience in regulated industries; prior experience working for Cloud Service Provider.

About Nebius

Nebius AI is an AI cloud platform with one of the largest GPU capacities in Europe. Launched in November 2023, the Nebius AI platform provides high-end, training-optimized infrastructure for AI practitioners. As an NVIDIA preferred cloud service provider, Nebius AI offers a variety of NVIDIA GPUs for training and inference, as well as a set of tools for efficient multi-node training. 

Nebius AI owns a data center in Finland, built from the ground up by the company’s R&D team and showcasing our commitment to sustainability. The data center is home to ISEG, the most powerful commercially available supercomputer in Europe and the 16th most powerful globally (Top 500 list, November 2023).  

Nebius’s headquarters are in Amsterdam, Netherlands, with teams working out of R&D hubs across Europe and the Middle East. 

Nebius AI is built with the talent of more than 500 highly skilled engineers with a proven track record in developing sophisticated cloud and ML solutions and designing cutting-edge hardware. This allows all the layers of the Nebius AI cloud – from hardware to UI – to be built in-house, distictly differentiating Nebius AI from the majority of specialized clouds: Nebius customers get a true hyperscaler-cloud experience tailored for AI practitioners. We’re growing and expanding our products every day. 

If you’re up to the challenge and are excited about AI and ML as much as we are, join us!

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

description:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

The role

HEX brings together creative talent, emerging technology and industry-leading partners to turn innovation into scalable solutions for our clients.

We’re looking for a Programme Director to lead the end-to-end delivery of a complex, high-profile programme at the intersection of creative production, AI and emerging technology.

You will translate strategic objectives into an integrated delivery plan, bring multiple workstreams together and ensure the programme delivers against its commitments. You’ll take ownership of programme governance, dependencies, risks and decisions, providing the clarity and control needed to navigate complexity and maintain momentum.

Working across senior leadership, technology partners, clients and multidisciplinary delivery teams, you’ll connect the bigger picture with the detail of execution, ensuring everyone is aligned on what needs to happen, when and why.

What you’ll do

Lead the programme

  • Own the integrated programme plan, translating objectives into clear workstreams, milestones, deliverables and success measures.
  • Establish effective governance, clear accountability and a consistent approach to programme reporting and decision-making.
  • Maintain oversight of the critical path, dependencies and delivery commitments, ensuring activity across workstreams comes together to achieve the overall programme objectives.
  • Provide a clear view of programme health, progress and emerging issues, giving leadership the information needed to make timely, informed decisions.

Drive delivery

  • Lead delivery across multiple workstreams, aligning teams on priorities, milestones and interdependencies.
  • Anticipate risks, resolve blockers and drive action on issues before they impact delivery.
  • Manage changes to scope, timelines and deliverables, assessing their implications and ensuring trade-offs are agreed and understood.
  • Challenge assumptions, address competing priorities and keep teams focused on the outcomes that matter most.
  • Hold workstream leads accountable for commitments, following through on actions and intervening where delivery is at risk.

 

Align clients and stakeholders

  • Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across WPP, technology partners and client organisations.
  • Create alignment across teams with different priorities, ensuring clear ownership, timely decisions and a shared understanding of programme objectives.
  • Lead programme reviews and executive reporting, communicating progress, risks, decisions and required actions with clarity.
  • Act as the central point of coordination for programme delivery, connecting stakeholders and ensuring commitments translate into action.

Deliver measurable outcomes

  • Maintain oversight of performance against programme objectives, milestones, budgets and agreed commercial commitments, working with the relevant commercial and finance leads.
  • Define and track success measures that demonstrate client adoption, business impact and value delivered.
  • Identify emerging delivery or commercial risks, making their implications visible and driving appropriate action.
  • Use performance data and programme insight to inform decisions, address underperformance and improve outcomes throughout the programme lifecycle.

What you’ll bring

  • Significant experience leading complex programmes involving multiple workstreams, interdependent deliverables and senior stakeholders.
  • A proven track record of translating strategic objectives into executable plans and delivering against challenging commitments.
  • Strong programme management expertise across integrated planning, governance, critical path management, risk, dependencies and change control.
  • The judgement to anticipate problems, navigate ambiguity and make effective decisions when priorities or delivery conditions change.
  • The confidence to challenge constructively, influence senior stakeholders and hold teams accountable across matrixed organisations.
  • Strong commercial awareness, including an understanding of budgets, forecasts and performance against agreed commitments.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to turn complex information into clear decisions, recommendations and executive-level reporting.
  • A proactive, collaborative approach, combining attention to detail with a clear focus on overall programme objectives.

Experience in creative production, digital transformation, AI-enabled programmes or technology partnerships would be advantageous.

What success looks like

  • A clear, integrated programme plan that connects workstreams, milestones, dependencies and outcomes.
  • Predictable, well-controlled delivery, with risks anticipated, blockers resolved and commitments actively managed.
  • Clear accountability across workstreams and strong alignment between clients, partners and delivery teams.
  • Timely, informed decision-making supported by transparent reporting and a reliable view of programme performance.
  • Measurable client outcomes, with clear evidence of adoption, business impact and value delivered.
  • A programme that meets its objectives while adapting effectively as priorities and requirements evolve.

We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

description:
About Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analyses that provide clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns.

CRA's European Competition practice specialises in providing economic advice on matters of competition policy and regulation. We assist firms and their legal advisors in all types of competition proceedings:  firms considering merger and acquisition opportunities or involved in merger control proceedings; and firms undergoing investigations relating to cartels, restrictive commercial agreements, abuse of dominance or state aid.  We also provide advice to firms involved in regulatory proceedings and sector inquiries. We offer assistance on the estimation effects of damages in cartel cases, international arbitration and intellectual property disputes.

Position Overview

The Senior Associate position is the entry-level position for applicants with a PhD in Economics and limited work experience. The Senior Associate position is also open to applicants with a Master of Economics and at least 3 years of relevant work experience, within economic consulting or with a competition authority. Candidates will be expected to rapidly take on genuine responsibility, working closely with senior consultants, scholars and industry experts on project teams, and will have the opportunity to immediately work on some of the largest, high-profile and most significant competition cases in Europe, providing conceptual and practical input to projects. A Senior Associate would typically:

  •  Conduct analyses and collect evidence from data and research that support our expert opinions and business recommendations
  •  Perform regression analyses in statistical analysis programs (such as Stata, Python, R), including large data projects requiring the use of cloud computing
  •  Build economic models tailored to the issues at hand and supporting our expert opinions and business recommendations
  •  Contribute to the development and presentation of client deliverables, including expert reports and white papers
  •  Interact with clients and communicate complicated economic concepts and arguments to non-experts in an understandable, accessible manner
  •  Manage and mentor junior staff
  • Ensure the integrity and accuracy of analyses and opinions
  • Participate in practice-building activities (training, recruiting, publication, expertise sharing, etc.)

Desired Qualifications

  • PhD in economics from a well-regarded institution with a strong foundation in microeconomics, preferably with a specialisation in industrial economics and/or econometrics; non-PhD applicants should have a Master of Economics and at least 3 years of relevant work experience, within economic consulting or with a competition authority
  • Fluency in English, other language skills are considered an asset
  • High degree of numeracy, ability to analyse data, familiarity with econometric techniques
  • Exceptional written and oral communication skills
  • Strong teamwork and collaboration capabilities
  • Excellent time management and task prioritisation skills
  • Clear and demonstrated interest in economic consulting through coursework, work experience, or activities

To Apply

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. To be considered for this position, submit through this job posting:

description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Senior Creative Strategist 

The Sr. Creative Strategist for UK/EU is a performance-minded, market-savvy leader who bridges global creative output with the nuances of European consumer behaviour. This person excels at identifying what's working in the US market and translating it for UK and German/French audiences; while also building the infrastructure to test, learn and scale independently. This person is energized by solving complex business problems, making high-judgment decisions in ambiguous environments, and turning insights into scalable, revenue-driving creative strategy.

Success in this role looks like:

  • Consistently identifying high-performing US creative and adapting it to drive customer acquisition and revenue growth in UK & DE/FR markets
  • Owning the experimentation framework that enables the EU/UK team to move fast, document learnings, and scale winners while maintaining strong alignment with brand identity
  • Serving as the primary creative liaison between UK & DE/FR market needs and the US creative and production teams
  • Improving win rates and spend efficiency through a rigorous, data-backed testing cadence
  • Acting as a strategic partner to the Director of Paid Social UK & DE/FR and cross-functional brand, design, and marketing teams
  • Leveraging data to inform strategic direction
  • This role is critical to establishing Paid Social as a core growth engine in the UK, Germany and France.

This role will be onsite 4-days a week based in London, Madrid, or Berlin. 

Responsibilities

Creative Adaptation & Briefing

  • Audit US creative performance regularly to identify high-potential concepts for UK & DE/FR adaptation
  • Brief the US creative team on market-specific adaptation needs; adjusting copy, tone, cultural references, pricing, and product focus for UK & DE/FR audiences
  • Commission net-new creative concepts where US assets are insufficient or market-specific angles are required
  • Write clear, detailed high converting ad briefs for video, static, UGC, and other ad formats with UK & DE/FR market context embedded
  • Ensure all adapted and net-new creative aligns with brand identity while resonating locally
  • Provide strategic feedback to designers and execute on feedback from leadership

Experimentation & Performance

  • Build and own a structured experimentation framework for UK & DE/FR paid social; covering hypothesis formation, test design, documentation, and results reporting
  • Prioritise and manage a live test pipeline across Meta (and other channels) to continuously improve creative performance
  • Analyse performance data in Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, and Looker; translate findings into clear strategic recommendations
  • Conduct consumer, competitor, and trend research specific to UK & DE/FR markets to inform creative direction
  • Identify winning patterns and codify them into repeatable brief templates and creative playbooks

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Serve as the EU/UK creative point of contact for the US production and strategy teams
  • Partner with the Director of Paid Social EU/UK on channel strategy, creative priorities, and growth planning
  • Collaborate with Brand, Design, and broader Marketing teams to align creative output across channels including affiliate, CRM, and PR

Qualifications

Required: 

  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • 5+ years of relevant creative and marketing experience
  • Paid Social and/or Direct Response experience required, with strong Meta expertise
  • Demonstrated experience working across markets; ideally including UK and/or DACH, with an understanding of how to adapt creative for different audiences
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and make confident creative decisions
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to write compelling briefs and copy across formats
  • Experience managing creative testing frameworks and reporting on results
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple briefs, markets, and workstreams simultaneously
  • Comfortable working across Google Suite (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Gmail)
  • Fluency in English required; German/French language skills a plus
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
  • Strong collaboration skills across creative and marketing teams

Preferred: 

  • Familiarity with TikTok, YouTube, Snapchat, or other paid platforms
  • Experience briefing and working with UGC creators
  • Background in DTC, fashion or e-commerce brands

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

Pay Range
£92,000—£101,000 GBP

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Senior Detection and Response Engineer (Cheltenham, UK)

Location: Cheltenham, UK

Team: Product & Engineering

Employment Type: Full-Time, Remote

About VulnCheck

Exploitation prevention is only as strong as the intelligence driving those efforts, and most of the industry is still running on intelligence that lacks exploit context. VulnCheck, The exploit intelligence company, delivers structured exploit intelligence on what is actively weaponized in the wild, purpose-built for the data lakes, ETL pipelines, automation, and AI and LLM workflows your infrastructure already runs on, raising the capability of everything it powers.

About the Role

Our Target and Canary Intelligence products provide unique visibility into vulnerable assets on the internet, attacker infrastructure, and attacks that leverage vulnerabilities for initial access. Target Intelligence maintains a continuously updated view of internet-facing systems — the services and versions they run, and their exposure to vulnerabilities. Canary Intelligence deploys intentionally vulnerable systems across the internet and captures real exploitation attempts as they happen.

We are looking for an experienced detection and response engineer to help scale the durable detections behind these products. These detections generate world-class, vulnerability-centric threat intelligence our customers rely on to defend themselves against exploitation activity on the internet.

You'll have wide latitude to shape how VulnCheck stays ahead of an accelerating volume of vulnerabilities - the tooling, the workflows, and the standards for detection engineering at scale. Although this is a 100% remote role, candidates must be located in or around Cheltenham, United Kingdom.

What You'll Do

  • Design and direct AI-assisted, agentic detection workflows that scale coverage to an accelerating volume of vulnerabilities, with you on the loop for quality
  • Author and ship network signatures and detections against internet-scale scan and probe data to identify services, versions, and whether hosts are vulnerable.
  • Build detections against Canary telemetry that separate real exploitation signal from internet noise, and synthesize that signal into threat intelligence customers can act on
  • Drive feedback loops into our probing and collection capabilities - identifying what data we should collect, what we shouldn't, and where coverage gaps exist
  • Continuously evaluate detection quality, measuring and tuning false positive and false negative rates
  • Respond rapidly when high-impact vulnerabilities drop - analyze, build coverage, ship
  • Work alongside our vulnerability researchers and threat hunters to connect detection engineering with exploit intelligence

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience building and shipping durable detections over network and host data
  • Experience scaling detection development and continuous evaluation processes using AI and agentic workflows with humans on the loop
  • A track record of researching, engineering, and validating durable detections across network and host telemetry, with a disciplined approach to false positives and false negatives
  • Expertise in device fingerprinting and protocol analysis. You understand the nuances of how services manifest on the wire, and how these signals stack to passively uncover what is running behind an open port on an internet address
  • Knowledge of attacker command-and-control techniques, covert channels, and exploitation artifacts — and how to identify them through network traffic analysis
  • A background in host-based analysis and DFIR. You know what telemetry is worth collecting from sensors to identify exploitation activity and attacker behaviors, and how to synthesize it into high-quality, actionable threat intelligence
  • Strong programming or scripting ability — you can codify detection logic so it is performant and integrates cleanly with VulnCheck’s engineering system
  • Familiarity with CVE, NVD, KEV, or exploit intelligence datasets
  • A response mindset — when a new vulnerability drops, you're the first to dig in, analyze it, and ship detection coverage

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing and tuning detections in Suricata, Snort, Zeek, or similar, and writing Nuclei templates or other scanner signatures
  • Published detection research, signatures, or open-source detection content
  • Experience with streaming systems or real-time data processing
  • Background in high-growth or startup environments

What We Offer

We believe people do their best work when they feel supported, trusted, and valued. VulnCheck offers benefits designed to meet a wide range of needs and lifestyles, tailored to your country of employment:

  • Generous, flexible time off
  • Retirement/pension plan contributions (e.g., 401k with match in the US; local pension schemes elsewhere)
  • Comprehensive healthcare coverage
  • Generous paid parental leave
  • Remote-friendly environment with flexibility
  • Support for home office costs (phone & internet)

Specific benefit details vary by country and are confirmed during the offer process.

Why Join Us

Built on over two decades of cybersecurity experience, our team of experts understands the intricacies of vulnerabilities, their exploitation in the wild, and how to leverage this data to build more effective cybersecurity products that produce better outcomes for organizations.

VulnCheck gives organizations a tactical advantage by providing best-in-class exploit & vulnerability intelligence information. We have a sense of duty to protect the critical infrastructure we rely on including medical devices, power grids and telecommunication networks. We were founded in 2021 in Lexington, Massachusetts.

VulnCheck has a transparent, collaborative, and supportive culture — we are looking for people who have a growth mindset, are curious and innovative. Our team is smart, but humble, hardworking, and supportive.

VulnCheck is proud to be an Equal Employer Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. VulnCheck is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with physical and mental disabilities. Wij ontwikkelen slimme, schaalbare en betrouwbare tools voor factuurverwerking, procurement, spend en document management, die naadloos integreren met een breed scala aan ERP-systemen. Vandaag de dag vertrouwen onze klanten op onze oplossingen. Vanuit kantoren in Breda, Rotterdam, Zoetermeer, De Goorn, Milton Keynes en Southampton werken ruim 140 medewerkers aan de doorontwikkeling en toepassing ervan, in een cultuur gebouwd op de kernwaarden betrokken, ambitieus, respectvol en daadkrachtig. Als Senior Implementatie Consultant speel je een sleutelrol: jij zorgt ervoor dat onze klanten succesvol live gaan én tevreden blijven. Je werkt nauw samen met 45 gedreven collega’s in het Support & Consultancy team. In een omgeving waar je je productkennis verder verdiept en je expertise volop kunt inzetten en uitbouwen. Doorgroeimogelijkheden Binnen Whitevision krijg je de ruimte om door te groeien naar rollen met meer strategische, organisatorische en internationale impact. Afhankelijk van jouw ambities kun je je ontwikkelen richting meer inhoudelijke diepgang (solution expert) of juist breder leiderschap als Lead of Manager binnen onze snelgroeiende internationale organisatie. description: About TACTILIA At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup. This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the electronics, actuators, and embedded systems that make that possible. You will join at the moment when the hard engineering questions become real product decisions: how do we make a highly capable robotic hand reliable, manufacturable, serviceable, and simple enough to deploy on a real shop floor? The Role As Senior Industrialization & Supply Chain Manager you will take ownership of the industrialization perspective throughout the product development process. Working closely with R&D, engineering and external manufacturing partners, you will ensure that manufacturing considerations are integrated into product design from the earliest development stages. You will challenge existing design decisions where necessary, identify more suitable manufacturing technologies and processes, and drive the transition from engineering concepts and prototypes to manufacturable, scalable products. This is a key role for someone who enjoys operating at the intersection of engineering, product development and manufacturing – and who is equally comfortable discussing technical trade-offs with R&D engineers, negotiating with suppliers and engaging directly with people on the production floor. What you will do: Drive industrialization from early product development: Work closely with R&D engineers from the beginning of the development process, integrating manufacturing expertise into design decisions and challenging concepts where necessary to improve manufacturability, cost and scalability. Define manufacturing strategies and technologies: Evaluate, select and implement appropriate manufacturing technologies, processes and production methods for complex mechanical and electromechanical components. Optimize product design for manufacturing: Identify opportunities to simplify designs, reduce component complexity, improve production feasibility and find more cost-effective manufacturing solutions without compromising product performance. Drive design for manufacturing of electronics and sensorics hardware: Work with R&D on the hardware design of electronics and sensor systems (PCBs, sensor modules, cabling and assembly) with manufacturing and supply chain requirements in mind. Ensure designs are producible, testable, cost-efficient and robust in series production. Develop external manufacturing partnerships: Identify and establish relationships with suitable manufacturing partners, particularly specialised SMEs. Work directly with company owners, technical experts and production teams to identify solutions and build reliable partnerships. Build up the supply chain and procurement strategy: Define and implement the supply chain and procurement strategy together with SCHUNK SE and external partners. Leverage SCHUNK's established supplier network and purchasing expertise where it makes sense, and build additional sourcing channels, including second sources, for critical components. Drive manufacturing readiness: Take ownership of manufacturing bottlenecks, technical feasibility, supplier lead times and production challenges, ensuring a smooth transition from prototypes to repeatable and scalable production. Build industrialization capabilities: Establish manufacturing processes, methods and standards that support TACTILIA's future growth and increasing production requirements. What you bring: Several years (5 years) of experience in industrialization, manufacturing engineering, production engineering or a comparable technical role. Broad knowledge of manufacturing technologies and processes, ideally involving complex mechanical, precision or electromechanical products. Proven experience translating engineering designs into practical, cost-efficient and manufacturable products. Experience with design for manufacturing of electronics and sensor hardware (PCB assembly, component selection, test strategies), ideally in an electromechanical or mechatronic product. Experience identifying, evaluating and working with external manufacturing partners and suppliers. Experience building or managing supply chains and procurement strategies, including working with a parent or group company's purchasing organization. Comfortable engaging with different stakeholders, from R&D engineers and senior management to supplier owners, technicians and blue-collar production teams. Entrepreneurial, pragmatic and hands-on mindset, with the ability to take ownership and drive topics independently. Strong communication skills and the confidence to challenge engineering decisions constructively. Fluent in English; German is an advantage. The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world. At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability and robustness to interact with the physical world at industrial scale. The technology is taking shape, the team is being built, and the standards around robotic hands and their skills are still open. That means your decisions will have a lasting impact — not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI. Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next. If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that work reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: Qui sommes-nous ? N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers, qui développe deux solutions : N2F et Vertical Expense. Notre mission : simplifier, automatiser et sécuriser la gestion des frais professionnels, tout en nous adaptant aux besoins et aux contextes parfois complexes de nos clients. Notre solution est très personnalisable, hautement interopérable, et déployée auprès de structures exigeantes, souvent multi-populations (collaborateurs nomades, agents, intérimaires, prestataires externes…). Pour accompagner notre croissance, nous renforçons l'équipe Sales de Vertical Expense. Tu y prendras en charge le développement de grands comptes publics et privés, sur des ventes complexes à forts enjeux. Tu auras pour mission de : Piloter le cycle de vente de bout en bout : qualification des opportunités, proposition de valeur différenciante, accès aux décideurs, négociation et closing. Développer de nouvelles opportunités par une prospection ciblée, en complément des leads apportés par le Marketing et par nos équipes Alliances & Channel. Analyser les besoins de tes prospects et présenter la solution, avec l'appui de l'avant-vente sur les projets complexes. Rédiger les réponses aux appels d'offres publics et privés (dont le mémoire technique), en t'appuyant sur les équipes internes. Assurer une passation fluide vers les équipes projets et CSM, et suivre les projets en appui après la signature. Participer aux réflexions stratégiques : veille concurrentielle, tendances du marché, différenciateurs produit. Ce qu'on va attendre de toi : Tu as une expérience significative et récente en vente complexe SaaS B2B auprès de grands comptes. Tu as déjà mené des cycles de vente longs, dans des organisations multi-décideurs, en travaillant avec des partenaires et des influenceurs. Founded in 2017, Laka set out to transform insurance by connecting passionate cyclists to form a collective and protect their bikes for when things go wrong - a better model for insurance was born. For once people come first in insurance by fairly sharing the cost amongst each other. We exist to rewrite the rules of insurance so it’s something people stand with, not against. Our model: Laka makes sure everything runs smoothly for The Collective - from exceptionally fast claims, splitting the cost fairly, guaranteeing a maximum price and all the other heavy lifting of a regulated insurance business. For that service, the collective pays Laka a fee relative to the claims in a month. Take a closer look at exactly what this means and how it works here. What have we been up to since then...? In a nutshell, we've been very busy! Here are a few of the massive achievements we've had: 🚀 Raised $10.4 million at series B! 🚀 Grown the team to over 60 Lakanauts, based across the UK and NL, enabling a choice-based, remote-first way of working 🚀 Launched Laka in a total of 11 countries, essentially helping more people in more places! 🚀 Captured the UK and NL enthusiast cyclist market and expanded into commercial business partnering 🚀 Been awarded 'Best Cycle Insurance Provider' (for the past 8 years in a row - go us! 🥳) 🚀 Opened 3 shiny new offices in London, Bristol & Amsterdam to provide spaces for people to collaborate as they like 🚀 We've also achieved a 5* rating on Google Reviews and Glassdoor - go check us out! Help us continue to change an outdated industry... We’re growing real fast on our path to make the Laka collective model the industry standard and we’re expanding across segments, products, and territories. We’re looking for innovative, bold and brave minds to help us build the world’s best insurance company. 🧮 Pricing at Laka Pricing our Collective is what makes Laka unique, so this role sits at the heart of what we do. Each month, members pay their share of the Collective's claims and a fee for Laka's services, up to their own cap. A stop loss from our insurers picks up anything above the total of all caps. Pricing it well means keeping the Collective healthy while balancing the interests of our members, Laka and our insurance partners. We have a fledgling pricing stack that we are looking to advance with your help. 🤘🏼 The role You'll own pricing across all five markets and both sides of our business. One side is cyclists who buy from us direct. The other is the partners who sell or bundle our cover, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and delivery fleets. It's a broad, hands-on role, working with our Pricing Analyst. What you'll be getting up to: Define and deliver pricing for our Collective in the UK and Europe: members' caps, rating factors and fees, based on claims frequency and severity by market and segment. Price our partner business, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and fleets, and support our Commercial team on new deals and renewals. Prepare rate reviews and pricing proposals for our insurance partners, and work with them on stop loss and capacity terms. Develop our pricing stack, tools and processes with Engineering and Data. Manage and develop our Pricing Analyst. You'll be successful by: Reviewing retail and partner pricing across all five markets in your first three months and agreeing priorities with us. Taking the first cap and fee changes live, with proposals our insurers approve first time. Taking our pricing stack to the next level within your first year. Requirements 🚀 Sound like you? 👉🏻 This role will be a great fit if you: Have 6+ years' experience in insurance pricing, with rate changes you've designed and taken live. Ideally have priced both direct-to-consumer and partner or B2B business: deep in one, credible in the other. Build pricing models in code: GLMs and GBMs in Python, with SQL. Are sharp and commercially minded, balancing growth, retention and profitability. Can explain technical work simply to partners, insurers and our leadership team. Have managed or mentored an analyst and are happy to stay hands-on. Already use AI tools like Claude and Claude Code, or are keen to make them core to how you work. Plus points: Actuarial exams (IFoA, AAG, DAV or Institut des Actuaires): welcome, but not required. We care most about what you've priced. Dutch, German or French. An interest in cycling. Benefits 🌟 Our perks 🏠 Remote-first way of working - you choose whether you work from home or our beautiful offices in London, Bristol and Amsterdam(we have no minimum expectation of how many days you come in, although we'd love to see your friendly face!) 📈 Share options - we want you to be rewarded for Laka's success - everyone in the business is granted share options when they join 💰 Performance driven scheme - if the company hits its targets, you'll get a cash bonus of 5% of your base salary annually 🌴 Annual leave - 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays), with the option to roll over up to 5 days per year 💶 Pension scheme - Laka pays 3% of your base salary into your pension to help you save for the future 💊 Private medical insurance - we’ll give you individual private cover, with the option to add partners & dependants too (at a small cost) 🍽 Lunch on us - £15 every first Wednesday of the month to enjoy lunch on Laka - pop out locally with people in the office, or order-in at home, the choice is yours 💃 Company-wide events - we love getting everyone together as much as possible - expect regular events throughout the year, for team building, bonding, and general good old-fashioned fun! 🎳 Monthly socials - as if quarterly company events weren't enough, we also give each office a budget for a monthly social activity (think anything from low-key dinner & drinks through to adventure golf, paddleboarding, bowling, electric darts, trampoline parks and more!) 👚 Laka swag - we'll give you some lovely Laka kit to get you started, including a jumper & t-shirts so you can feel (& look) like part of the family 🚴 Laka credit - for all you cyclists, we'll give you £10 credit per month towards insuring your bike(s) with us - plus give you access to a bunch of cycling industry discounts 🧠 Mental health support - unlimited support via Spill, including one-to-one therapy sessions 🌈 Belonging at Laka We're committed to building and sustaining a business that promotes diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging - our customer collective is broad and inclusive, and we'd like our own people to be too. We're fast becoming a global community of people and we believe each person's unique qualities should be celebrated as they are a huge part of what makes Laka a great place to be. We'd love you to bring your authentic self to work every single day, no matter your age, ethnicity, religion, citizenship, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, caring responsibilities, neurodiversity, or anything else that makes you, you. description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

#LI-MM1

We’re looking for a Software Engineer with strong C++ expertise to join the team building and operating Nebius Data Platform — a distributed storage and a processing platform that acts as the company’s “source of truth” and the backbone of many internal (and some external) products.

Nebius Data Platform is a single multi-tenant ecosystem based on YTsaurus — instead of running separate HDFS/Kafka/HBase-style systems, we provide storage, compute, and analytics capabilities inside one platform.

Built on top of the open-source YTsaurus ecosystem, we run and extend our own Nebius distribution and develop significant in-house functionality (core and platform-level). We can design, implement, and roll out features end-to-end on our clusters without waiting for upstream approvals and contribute upstream when it makes sense.

At scale today, this includes~500 servers, ~20k CPU cores and ~10 PB of compressed data in our largest production cluster, supporting workloads ranging from business-critical pipelines and financial transactions to large-scale ML/LLM training datasets and compute.

What’s inside the platform

You’ll work on a system that includes (and ties together):

  • Distributed Storage (Cypress): transactional semantics, tiered storage, erasure coding, replication, and strong reliability expectations.
  • Compute & ETL: a cluster-wide job scheduler (tens of thousands of cores), MapReduce, YQL for SQL-like data processing, and SPYT (Spark over YTsaurus) for modern data engineering.
  • Interactive analytics (CHYT): ClickHouse® instances spun up directly on compute nodes for fast SQL over data in-place.
  • Dynamic Tables: low-latency NoSQL KV with distributed ACID transactions for OLTP-style workloads and feature stores.
  • Orchestracto: workflow orchestration deeply integrated with the platform (Airflow-like, but platform-native).

What you’ll do

We’re looking for engineers who combine strong systems skills with product sense: understanding who uses the platform, why certain capabilities matter, and making pragmatic trade-offs to maximize impact. On our team, engineering work is expected to be connected to real users and outcomes — you’ll regularly align with internal stakeholders, clarify requirements, and help drive prioritization.

In this role, you will:

  • Design and implement new functionality in YTsaurus core (C++) with production reliability in mind.
  • Build and evolve platform-level capabilities: platform architecture and operating model—multi-cluster growth, shared primitives, and a consistent experience that scales with new teams and use cases.
  • Improve end-to-end platform experience for internal (and external-facing) users: APIs, guardrails, debugging workflows, and automation.
  • Own production quality: incident response / on-call rotation, root cause analysis, and turning learnings into durable fixes.

Example projects

  • Roll out sharded YTsaurus masters (incl. Kubernetes operator support) and build automatic balancing of metadata across master cells (consensus groups) to remove control-plane bottlenecks and unlock 10–100x cluster growth.

description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Product

In a rapidly evolving world, trust in AI depends on AI agents being grounded in fresh, verified real-world data. Search is the foundation that makes this possible.

We are building an agent-native search platform designed specifically for AI systems rather than human users. Our product provides programmatic, low-latency, and observable search APIs that AI agents use to retrieve, filter, and reason over real-world information at scale.

The Role

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to work on the indexing and data processing layer of a novel search engine tailored for agentic AI consumption.

In this role, you will focus on building systems that ingest, process, and organise massive volumes of data into efficient, queryable structures. You will work primarily on offline and nearline pipelines, ensuring that data is fresh, complete, and efficiently accessible by downstream retrieval systems. You will operate in an environment where throughput, scalability, and correctness are critical; designing systems capable of handling tens of gigabytes per second across continuously evolving datasets.

In this position, your responsibility will be to:

  • Design, implement, and operate large-scale indexing systems and data pipelines that sit at the core of our search infrastructure
  • Develop and optimise indexing strategies balancing performance, freshness, and resource efficiency
  • Work on storage formats, compaction strategies, and update mechanisms to keep data accessible and current
  • Ensure reliability and predictability of pipelines under high-throughput conditions
  • Build well-tested components with clear responsibilities and interaction contracts, while remaining flexible as the system evolves
  • Define and implement observability primitives, including structured logs, metrics, and data quality signals across offline and nearline pipelines
  • Monitor throughput, resource usage, and cost, and drive optimisations when business needs require it
  • Collaborate with runtime and ML teams to ensure indexing outputs meet retrieval and ranking requirements
  • Enable safe experimentation on indexing strategies and data processing logic through controlled rollouts and clearly defined quality signals

You may be a good fit if you:

  • 8+ years of experience building production backend or data infrastructure systems
  • Strong Go experience (C++/Rust is a plus)
  • Experience with large-scale data processing systems (10+ GiB/sec throughput, petabyte-scale datasets, etc.)
  • Experience building or operating databases, storage systems, data planes, or indexing pipelines
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, fault tolerance, consistency, and scalability
  • Experience running production systems and handling operational incidents
  • Systems-thinking mindset and ability to reason about end-to-end data flows

Strong candidates may also have experience with:

  • Distributed data processing frameworks such as Spark, Flink, MapReduce, or Beam
  • Content systems including, scraping, proxying, or anti-bot infrastructure
  • Ad tech, social networks, or other large-scale content platforms
  • DBMS internals (open source or SaaS) and cloud infrastructure
  • Open-source contributions or active involvement in the engineering community
  • Competitive programming or CTF participation (ICPC, IOI, or similar)
  • SHAD or similar advanced technical programmes
  • Conference talks or technical publications

 

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

  • Competitive compensation

  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

description: Over Nedlin Nedlin is een industriële textielverzorger voor Healthcare, Hospitality en Industry, waar veiligheid, kwaliteit, continu verbeteren en verantwoord ondernemen centraal staan. Als groeiend B-Corp familiebedrijf investeren we graag in jong talent en versterken we de verbinding tussen onderwijs en arbeidsmarkt. Daarom bieden we studenten de kans om praktijkervaring op te doen, zich te ontwikkelen en Nedlin te leren kennen, met waar mogelijk mooie doorgroeikansen na het afstuderen. De stageopdracht Tijdens deze hbo-stage ga je aan de slag met Lock Out Tag Out (LOTO). LOTO is een veiligheidsmethode waarbij machines en energiebronnen tijdens onderhoud of werkzaamheden veilig worden uitgeschakeld en vergrendeld. Zo wordt voorkomen dat een machine onverwacht wordt ingeschakeld terwijl eraan wordt gewerkt. Jij helpt Nedlin om deze werkwijze verder te ontwikkelen, te standaardiseren en praktisch toepasbaar te maken. Je onderzoekt de huidige LOTO-werkwijze en brengt risico’s, energiebronnen en isolatiepunten in kaart. Je ontwikkelt een uniforme LOTO-procedure en machine-specifieke LOTO-kaarten. Je brengt de benodigde materialen en hulpmiddelen in kaart. Je ontwikkelt instructie- en toolboxmateriaal voor medewerkers. Je stelt een praktisch implementatieadvies op om LOTO binnen Nedlin verder te borgen. Wat bieden wij? Stagevergoeding: € 300,- bruto per maand voor mbo-studenten (op basis van 40 uur per week); € 400,- bruto per maand voor hbo-studenten (op basis van 40 uur per week); Een leerzame stage binnen één van de modernste en duurzaamste wasserijen van Europa; Ruimte en begeleiding om te werken aan jouw (afstudeer)opdracht; Persoonlijke begeleiding en korte lijnen; Een familiaire en positieve sfeer: samen feestdagen vieren, een jaarlijkse familiedag en leuke uitjes; Kans op een (bij)baan bij Nedlin na afronding van je stage, bij wederzijdse match. Veiligheid tijdens je stage Veiligheid staat ook tijdens de uitvoering van de stageopdracht voorop. Je voert daarom geen risicovolle onderhoudswerkzaamheden zelfstandig uit. Eventuele technische aanpassingen worden uitsluitend uitgevoerd door bevoegde medewerkers of externe partijen. Machinekaarten worden vóór ingebruikname gevalideerd door de Technische Dienst. Wie ben jij? Je volgt een hbo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld Integrale Veiligheidskunde, Technische Bedrijfskunde, Werktuigbouwkunde, Elektrotechniek, Engineering of Facility Management. Je hebt interesse in techniek en veiligheid en combineert graag theorie met praktijk. Je werkt zelfstandig, nauwkeurig en proactief en communiceert gemakkelijk met collega’s. Je bent 32 tot 40 uur per week beschikbaar voor een meewerk- en/of afstudeerstage. Je kunt zelfstandig naar onze locatie in Elsloo of Hoensbroek reizen. Pak het moment Wil jij tijdens je stage niet alleen werken aan een interessante opdracht, maar vooral ook leren, ervaring opdoen en jezelf ontwikkelen? Bij Nedlin krijg je de ruimte om jouw kennis vanuit je opleiding toe te passen in de praktijk, mee te kijken binnen onze organisatie en samen te werken met ervaren collega’s. Maak van jouw stage een waardevolle stap richting je toekomst. Solliciteer eenvoudig via de solliciteerknop. Heb je eerst nog vragen over de stage of de opdracht? description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Hoe versterken we de reputatie van één van de grootste werkgevers van Nederland? Welke influencers schakelen we in bij een lancering van een nieuw product? Hoe zorgen we dat de onze klant goed in de media komt? Als jouw hart sneller gaat kloppen van deze vragen, dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Wat ga je doen?

Stage lopen bij Burson betekent dat je meteen veel verantwoordelijkheden krijgt. Als stagiair maak je écht onderdeel uit van ons team en word je zoveel mogelijk betrokken bij verschillende activiteiten.

Je werkt nauw samen met je collega’s aan opdrachten voor merken zoals SharkNinja, Jaguar Land Rover en Procter & Gamble (o.a. Gillette, Always en Olay). Afhankelijk van de klanten in jouw portfolio ondersteun je bijvoorbeeld bij andere inhoudelijke taken als het verzamelen van relevante informatie, het maken van media-, concurrentie- of stakeholderanalyses, het meedenken over de invulling van nieuwe social media- of influencer-campagnes en het creëren van content voor verschillende kanalen. Er wordt hard gewerkt in de diverse klantteams, maar de werksfeer is open, informeel en eigen initiatief wordt zeer gewaardeerd!

Wie zijn wij?

Burson staat voor strategie en communicatie, met adviseurs die door opdrachtgevers worden ingeschakeld als het er echt om gaat. Wij helpen bedrijven en organisaties in de meest uiteenlopende en vaak uitdagende omstandigheden, waarbij wij ze adviseren in hun transities en transformaties. Met het creëren van stakeholderacceptatie als doel. Nooit om de status quo te beschermen, niet om op elke hype in te gaan, maar om ze met een gegronde strategie toekomstbestendig te maken.

Onze adviseurs zijn met hun brede ervaring, vakmanschap en integriteit erkende boardroompartners. Onafhankelijk en kritisch zetten zij de discussie met onze opdrachtgevers op scherp. Burson heeft jarenlange ervaring in het adviseren van bedrijven in complexe situaties, onder meer op het gebied van strategie, stakeholdermanagement en geloofwaardige communicatie.

We zijn onderdeel van Burson Group, een internationaal communicatiebureau bestaande uit een groot netwerk met meer dan 95 kantoren in ruim 40 landen. Samen maken wij onderdeel uit van WPP: het grootste marketing- en communicatiebedrijf ter wereld. Sinds 2019 zijn wij onder één dak gevestigd op onze Amsteldok-campus in Amsterdam. Daarnaast hebben wij in Nederland ook een kantoor in Den Haag.

Wie ben jij?

Heb jij je altijd al afgevraagd hoe het is om stage te lopen bij een internationaal communicatiebureau? Ben je goed op de hoogte van het laatste nieuws? Weet je je weg te vinden in de onlinewereld? Ben je communicatief vaardig, leergierig en stel je altijd de juiste vragen? Dan past deze stage perfect bij jou.

Je staat open voor nieuwe ideeën en opvattingen, bent breed geïnteresseerd en zoekt graag dingen tot op de bodem uit. Bij ons zijn studenten van alle studieachtergronden welkom die geïnteresseerd zijn in communicatie, marketing en media.

Wat bieden wij?

Tijdens je stage ontvang je een maandelijkse stagevergoeding van €650 (gebaseerd op een volledige werkweek) en word je begeleid door twee collega’s. Elke maand heb je een coachingsgesprek over je eigen ambities en wensen. Halverwege je stage is er een tussentijds feedbackgesprek waarin genoeg ruimte is om aan te geven wat je nog meer uit je stage wil halen. Daarnaast kun je altijd terecht bij andere Young Professionals (trainees), consultants en senior-adviseurs met vragen. Tenslotte worden je reiskosten vergoed en is het mogelijk om op vrijdagen  vanuit huis te werken.

Enthousiast?

Solliciteer dan via onderstaande link!

Je kunt solliciteren t/m 1 december. De gesprekken zullen dan in de weken erna plaatsvinden. De startdatum van de stage is flexibel, maar idealiter 1 februari.

We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. description: Mines Saint-Etienne est une Ecole de l’Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT), 1er groupe public d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management en France. L’École Nationale Supérieure des Mines de Saint-Étienne (Mines Saint-Etienne) est chargée de missions de formation, de recherche et d’innovation, de transfert vers l’industrie et de culture scientifique, technique et industrielle. Mines Saint-Etienne représente: 2 400 élèves-ingénieurs et chercheurs en formation, 480 personnels (150 Chercheurs et Enseignants-chercheurs), un budget consolidé de 46 M€, 3 campus dédiés à l’industrie à Saint-Etienne et Lyon (région AURA), à la microélectronique et aux objets connectés à Gardanne (Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence, région SUD) et à l’ingénierie pour la santé à Saint-Etienne ; 6 unités de recherche ; 5 centres de formation et de recherche ; un centre de culture scientifique technique et industrielle leader en France « La Rotonde » (> 50 000 visiteurs / an). Contexte scientifique et objectifs du stage : Problématique : Renforcer l'attractivité des formations Mastère Spécialisé en alternance auprès des étudiants et des entreprises, en développant les actions de développement commercial et de recrutement. Commercialisation de la formation Mastère Spécialisé IoT en alternance Étude de marché : Analyser les besoins des entreprises et des étudiants en matière d'alternance, en lien avec les thématiques des cursus concernés Identifier les tendances du marché (secteurs porteurs, compétences recherchées). Stratégie commerciale : Participer à l'élaboration de plans d'action pour promouvoir la formations MS : salons, webinaires, campagnes digitales. Prospection et fidélisation : Contacter des entreprises pour leur présenter les avantages de l'alternance. Participer aux évènements professionnels pour promouvoir l’offre de formations MS. Suivre et analyser les retours des entreprises et étudiants. B. Recrutement d'étudiants et d'entreprises Recrutement des étudiants : Animer des sessions d'information pour les étudiants (présentation des MS, témoignages d'anciens). Collaborer avec les écoles et universités pour cibler les profils adaptés. Recrutement des entreprises : Identifier et contacter des entreprises potentielles. C. Gestion administrative et reporting Sous la responsabilité du service recrutement des formations Mastère Spécialisé, suivre l’évolution des candidatures étudiants et des propositions d’alternance. 🔍 Ce que nous recherchons : · Master en commercialisation/marketing avec une dominante digitale · Appétence pour l’innovation, l’industrie, la technologie · Ouverture d’esprit et capacité d’écoute · Capacité à évoluer dans un environnement pluridisciplinaire scientifique · Autonome · Travail en équipe · Capacité à assurer un reporting régulier · Savoir expliquer et défendre ses choix 🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre les Mines de Saint-Etienne ? Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l'excellence, avec la conviction qu'ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde. Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c'est l'opportunité de trouver : Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un cadre de travail accueillant et un solide réseau international (T.I.M.E., EULiST). Dit is P1 P1 Travel is het grootste sportevenementen Ticketing bureau van Europa en wij werken officieel samen met de grootste voetbalclubs, stadions en toernooien ter wereld. Denk aan clubs als Manchester United, Liverpool, FC Barcelona en SSC Napoli, maar ook de Olympische spelen, Formule 1 en Wimbledon. Wij brengen zakelijke en particuliere klanten naar het evenement van hun dromen. Jij kunt hier onderdeel van uitmaken in de vorm van een stage bij ons Finance team. Feeling met sport en cijfers? Aan het finance team de taak om in samenwerking met de rest van de organisatie te zorgen voor kloppende cijfers waarop gestuurd kan worden. Finance & Control stage Gedurende je stage zal je compleet onderdeel zijn van het team en zorgen we voor een gevarieerd takenpakket. Je eerste weken staan in het teken van kennismaken met onze processen en werkwijzes. Daarna zul je aan de slag gaan met je eigen takenpakket. Hierbij kun je denken aan: Maken van periodieke en ad hoc rapportages; Meewerken aan financiële maand- en jaarafsluitingen; Uitvoeren van checks en controles op o.a juistheid en volledigheid van financiële data en processen; Maken van resultaatboekingen op events en het analyseren daarvan. Naast het op doen van waardevolle ervaring in de organisatie gaan we graag met je in gesprek over grote en uitdagende projecten die P1 en jou verder helpt in de ontwikkeling. Bijvoorbeeld het zelf opzetten van managementrapportages. Je bent pro-actief, wil zoveel mogelijk leren en steekt graag de handen uit de mouwen. Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal. Mooi meegenomen als je zelf ook een passie hebt voor sport, dat hebben wij namelijk ook! Waar kom je terecht? We zijn gevestigd in het mooie Leiden en je komt terecht in een gezellig én ambitieus bedrijf waar geen dag hetzelfde is. We bestaan momenteel uit een groep van 80 collega’s en werken elk semester met een leuke groep van stagiaires verdeeld over verschillende afdelingen. Je zult dus zeker niet de enige zijn die van start gaat. Dit krijg jij ervoor terug! Naast een afwisselende stage en goede begeleiding wordt er verder goed voor je gezorgd. Denk hierbij aan een gaaf kantoor voorzien van alle gemakken, verzorgde lunch, sportmogelijkheden en de vetste uitjes met de hele toko. Elke stagiair die wij hebben gehad kijkt terug op een onvergetelijke tijd. ''It’s all about unforgettable experiences!'' Enthousiast geworden? Goed om te horen! Laat snel van je horen via de solliciteerknop door je CV en een motivatie te sturen. Is deze stage niet helemaal wat je zoekt? Check dan zeker ook nog even de andere stagevacatures. description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Stage Public Affairs bij Burson

Wil jij ervaring opdoen op het snijvlak van politiek, media, bestuur en bedrijfsleven?

Burson staat voor strategie en communicatie, met adviseurs die door opdrachtgevers worden ingeschakeld als het er echt om gaat. Met ons ervaren team van specialisten opereren we op hoog strategisch niveau en helpen we bedrijven en organisaties door de meest complexe situaties: van het versterken of beschermen van reputaties tot het inspelen op veranderende wetgeving, het agenderen van politieke thema’s, het begeleiden van fusies en overnames, productintroducties of crisiscommunicatie. We zijn onderdeel van Burson Group, een internationaal communicatiebureau bestaande uit een groot netwerk met meer dan 95 kantoren in ruim 40 landen. Samen maken wij onderdeel uit van WPP: het grootste marketing- en communicatiebedrijf ter wereld. Sinds 2019 zijn wij onder één dak gevestigd op onze Amsteldok-campus in Amsterdam. Daarnaast hebben wij in Nederland ook een kantoor in Den Haag.

Public Affairs bij Burson is veel meer dan lobbyen op het Binnenhof. In de huidige mediacratie wordt beleid steeds vaker beïnvloed door publieke opinie en politieke sentimenten. Hierdoor verschuift de macht: niet alleen overheid en markt bepalen de agenda, maar ook de samenleving zelf.  Onze adviseurs helpen organisaties om in te spelen op deze dynamiek: maatschappelijke trends signaleren, draagvlak creëren bij uiteenlopende stakeholders, en strategieën ontwikkelen die zowel politiek als publiek overtuigen.

Als geïntegreerd communicatieadviesbureau weten wij hoe we Public Affairs versterken met slimme PR en gerichte communicatie, zodat we de juiste doelgroep bereiken, op het juiste moment, via het juiste kanaal, met de juiste boodschap. Daardoor richten ons op het beïnvloeden van relevante stakeholders via een breed scala aan kanalen.

Burson stelt jaarlijks per 1 februari en 1 september een Public Affairs stage beschikbaar aan een talentvolle student.

Wat ga je doen?

Als stagiair Public Affairs werk je mee aan diverse projecten en ondersteun je onze adviseurs. Je maakt kennis met veel aspecten van het werk binnen een Public Affairs kantoor en krijgt een uniek kijkje achter de schermen van de politieke arena. Je leert hoe organisaties hun belangen behartigen richting politiek, overheid en media. Kortom: een veelzijdige stage op het raakvlak van politiek, bestuur, media en bedrijfsleven.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Monitoren van nieuws en politiek:dagelijks kranten, vakbladen en opinietijdschriften scannen op relevant nieuws voor onze klanten.
  • Volgen van parlementaire agenda’s:bijhouden van vergaderingen en debatten in de Tweede en Eerste Kamer, relevante Kamerstukken signaleren en samenvatten.
  • Verslaglegging: live en achteraf rapporteren over politieke debatten en griffieverslagen verzamelen.
  • Research en analyse: informatie verzamelen via databanken en analyses maken voor onze adviseurs.
  • Stakeholdermapping: relevante politieke en ambtelijke contacten in kaart brengen en up-to-date houden.
  • Ondersteuning bij diverse klantprojecten: bijdragen aan presentaties, pitches en strategische adviezen.

Wie ben jij?

  • Je volgt een HBO- of universitaire opleiding, bijvoorbeeld Politicologie, Bestuurskunde, Geschiedenis, Europese Studies of Internationale Betrekkingen (en staat ingeschreven tijdens de stageperiode).
  • Je hebt een grote interesse in en kennis van de Nederlandse politiek en maatschappelijke vraagstukken.
  • Je bent proactief, nieuwsgierig en analytisch sterk.
  • Je kunt complexe informatie helder analyseren en samenvatten en hebt een vlotte pen.
  • Je beheerst de Nederlands en Engels taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.
  • Je kunt goed omgaan met deadlines en werkt nauwkeurig, ook onder druk.
  • Je bent minimaal vier dagen per week beschikbaar in de periode van 1 februari tot en met 30 juni.

Wat bieden wij

Tijdens je stage ontvang je een maandelijkse stagevergoeding van €650 (gebaseerd op een volledige werkweek) en word je begeleid door twee collega’s. Elke maand heb je een coachingsgesprek over je eigen ambities en wensen. Halverwege je stage is er een tussentijds feedbackgesprek waarin genoeg ruimte is om aan te geven wat je nog meer uit je stage wil halen. Daarnaast kun je altijd terecht bij andere Young Professionals, consultants en senior-adviseurs met vragen. Tenslotte worden je reiskosten vergoed en is het mogelijk om zo nu en dan eens vanuit huis te werken.

Neben dem Studium willst du an Software arbeiten, die jemand am nächsten Tag benutzt, statt an einem Teilstück, dessen Nutzer du nie siehst. Du baust Oberflächen, Dashboards und interne Werkzeuge vom ersten Prototyp bis zu etwas, das ohne dich läuft. Dein Maßstab: Ein Berater würde es vermissen, wenn es abgeschaltet wird. Daten und Integration Du baust die Datenstrecken mit, die jede Nacht Daten aus DATEV und unseren anderen Systemen in unsere eigene Datenschicht laden, von Anfang an mit Prüfungen. Du legst Kennzahlen so an, dass jede Zahl in jedem Werkzeug und jedem Bericht dasselbe bedeutet. Du hilfst, die Systeme jedes übernommenen Hauses anzubinden, ohne dass daraus jedes Mal ein eigenes Projekt wird. Agenten und Automatisierung Du baust Agenten für wiederkehrende Arbeit mit und ziehst dabei die Linie zwischen dem, was das Modell beurteilt, und dem, was fest gerechnet wird. Du sorgst dafür, dass jedes Ergebnis nachvollziehbar ist: welche Version, welche Quelle, welche Entscheidung. Du prüfst gegen abgeschlossene, geprüfte Fälle statt gegen Testdaten. Deine Perspektiven Was du nach 3 Monaten geliefert hast: Ein erstes Werkzeug von dir wird von einem Team im Alltag genutzt. Du kennst die Datenstrecken aus DATEV und arbeitest sicher in unserer Entwicklungsumgebung. Andere bauen auf deinem Code auf, und deine Pull Requests gehen ohne große Nacharbeit durch. Was du nach 12 Monaten geliefert hast: Du arbeitest wie ein Engineer im Team und nicht wie eine Aushilfe. Der Einstieg nach dem Master ist konkret: als Founding Engineer oder mit verlängerter Werkstudentenzeit bis zum Abschluss. Wohin sich die Stelle entwickelt: Werkstudent bei Vogel ist der Weg in den Berufseinstieg als Founding Engineer. Danach wächst du in die Verantwortung für einen eigenen Produktbereich, in der fachlichen Expertenlaufbahn oder in der Führungslaufbahn. Der Beitrag entscheidet, nicht das Berufsjahr. Was du baust, muss neben dem laufenden Betrieb funktionieren. FAQ 1. Was ist Vogel – und wo arbeitet ihr? Vogel ist eine der führenden Mittelstandsberatungen Deutschlands – seit 1959, inhabergeführt in zweiter Generation, mit eigenem Kapital – und baut daraus die führende Beratungsplattform für den Mittelstand. Wir arbeiten an drei Standorten: Aalen als gewachsenem Stammsitz, Bopfingen im Kerngeschäft und München als neuem Hub. An allen dreien suchen wir quer durch die Funktionen – von Steuerberatung über Beratung bis zu den Teams, die das Fundament darunter bauen. 2. Wie sind die Gehaltsbänder zu verstehen? Bewusst breit – und an jeder Stelle ausgewiesen, bevor du dich bewirbst. Wir differenzieren nach Track Record und Marktwert, nicht nach Abschluss: knappe, stark gefragte Profile am oberen Ende, weniger knappe am unteren.
